entries.definition: Give the colimit of the underlying sets the topology in which an open subset is detected by all of its inverse images at diagram objects.

entries.subject: group-with-topology
entries.name: Topological group
entries.definition: Group multiplication on the product and group inversion are continuous for the given topology.

entries.subject: group-hom-between-topological-groups
entries.name: Homomorphism of topological groups
entries.definition: The specified algebraic group homomorphism is continuous.

entries.subject: group-with-topology
entries.name: Continuous group multiplication
entries.definition: Multiplication from the product group space to the group is continuous.

entries.subject: group-with-topology
entries.name: Continuous inversion
entries.definition: Inversion on the group is continuous.

entries.topic: Sets equipped with the discrete topology
entries.subject: discrete-set
entries.name: Pointwise-convergence topology on selfmaps of a discrete set
entries.definition: Basic neighbourhoods prescribe the values of a selfmap on finitely many elements. This is the compact-open topology when the domain is discrete.

entries.subject: group-with-topology
entries.name: Profinite topological group
entries.definition: The group operations are continuous and the underlying space is profinite. Equivalently it is a cofiltered limit of finite discrete groups as a topological group.
refs: Stacks 0BR2 · definition by the equivalent criteria

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Zariski covering family
entries.definition: The morphisms in the family jointly cover the target by open immersions.

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Standard Zariski covering family
entries.definition: The target is affine. There are finitely many affine domains, the images cover the target, and the morphisms identify the domains with principal opens of the target.
refs: Stacks 020R · Standard family over an affine target

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: étale covering family
entries.definition: The morphisms in the family are étale and jointly surjective.
refs: Milne, Lectures on Étale Cohomology, §5, The étale site on X, p. 39

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Standard étale covering family
entries.definition: The target is affine. There are finitely many affine domains, the images cover the target, and the morphisms are étale.
refs: Stacks 0219 · Standard family over an affine target

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: smooth covering family
entries.definition: The morphisms in the family are smooth and jointly surjective.

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Standard smooth covering family
entries.definition: The target is affine. There are finitely many affine domains, the images cover the target, and the morphisms are standard smooth.
refs: Stacks 0223 · Standard family over an affine target

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: syntomic covering family
entries.definition: The morphisms in the family are syntomic and jointly surjective.

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Standard syntomic covering family
entries.definition: The target is affine. There are finitely many affine domains, the images cover the target, and the morphisms are standard syntomic.
refs: Stacks 0229 · Standard family over an affine target

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: fppf covering family
entries.definition: The morphisms in the family are flat and locally of finite presentation and are jointly surjective.

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Standard fppf covering family
entries.definition: The target is affine. There are finitely many affine domains, the images cover the target, and the morphisms are flat and of finite presentation.
refs: Stacks 021Q · Standard family over an affine target

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: fpqc covering family
entries.definition: All arrows are flat. For each affine open $U$ of the target there are finitely many affine opens of domains of the family whose images have union exactly $U$. The same domain may be used more than once.
refs: Stacks 022B · Flatness and finite affine lifting over every affine open
Vistoli, §2.3.2, Proposition 2.33(i)–(ii), Definition 2.34 and the paragraph after Proposition 2.35, pp. 29–30

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Standard fpqc covering family
entries.definition: The target and all domains are affine, the family is finite, its arrows are flat, and their images cover the target.

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Standard ph covering family
entries.definition: Over an affine target, take a proper surjection and restrict it to the members of a finite affine open cover of its source. The given family is obtained in this way.
refs: Stacks 0DBD · Standard family from a proper surjection

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: ph covering family
entries.definition: All arrows are locally of finite type. After restriction to every affine open of the target the family admits a standard ph refinement.
refs: Stacks 0DBG · Local finite type and affine-local refinement

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Standard V covering family
entries.definition: The target and the finitely many domains are affine. For every map $\operatorname{Spec}(V)\to T$ from a valuation ring, there are an injective local extension of valuation rings $V\to W$ and a lift from $\operatorname{Spec}(W)$ to one domain over $T$.
refs: Stacks 0ETB · Valuative lifting for finite families of affines
Bhatt–Mathew, The arc-topology, Definition 1.1 (valuative criterion on qcqs schemes)

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: V covering family
entries.definition: For each affine open of the target the restricted family admits a refinement by a standard V covering.
refs: Bhatt–Mathew, The arc-topology, Definition 1.1 (valuative criterion on qcqs schemes)

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Size-bounded big Zariski site
entries.definition: Start with a set of schemes and a set of Zariski coverings among them. Enlarge to a Stacks category of schemes closed under the prescribed constructions and choose a set of covering families with the refinement and closure properties in the Stacks construction.
refs: Stacks 020S · Construction from starting objects and coverings

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Big affine Zariski site over a scheme
entries.definition: Fix a scheme S belonging to a chosen big Zariski site. Use the full subcategory of affine schemes over S, with the standard Zariski coverings inherited from the big slice.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Small affine Zariski site
entries.definition: Fix a scheme S belonging to a chosen big Zariski site. Retain affine objects of the small site and the standard Zariski families among its coverings.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Size-bounded big étale site
entries.definition: Start with a set of schemes and a set of étale coverings among them. Enlarge to a Stacks category of schemes closed under the prescribed constructions and choose a set of covering families with the refinement and closure properties in the Stacks construction.
refs: Stacks 021A · Construction from starting objects and coverings

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Big affine étale site over a scheme
entries.definition: Fix a scheme S belonging to a chosen big étale site. Use the full subcategory of affine schemes over S, with the standard étale coverings inherited from the big slice.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Small affine étale site
entries.definition: Fix a scheme S belonging to a chosen big étale site. Retain affine objects of the small site and the standard étale families among its coverings.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Size-bounded big smooth site
entries.definition: Start with a set of schemes and a set of smooth coverings among them. Enlarge to a Stacks category of schemes closed under the prescribed constructions and choose a set of covering families with the refinement and closure properties in the Stacks construction.
refs: Stacks 03WY · Construction from starting objects and coverings

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Big smooth site over a scheme
entries.definition: Fix a scheme S belonging to a chosen big smooth site. Form the slice over S with its inherited covering families.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Big affine smooth site over a scheme
entries.definition: Fix a scheme S belonging to a chosen big smooth site. Use the full subcategory of affine schemes over S, with the standard smooth coverings inherited from the big slice.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Size-bounded big syntomic site
entries.definition: Start with a set of schemes and a set of syntomic coverings among them. Enlarge to a Stacks category of schemes closed under the prescribed constructions and choose a set of covering families with the refinement and closure properties in the Stacks construction.
refs: Stacks 03X1 · Construction from starting objects and coverings

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Big syntomic site over a scheme
entries.definition: Fix a scheme S belonging to a chosen big syntomic site. Form the slice over S with its inherited covering families.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Big affine syntomic site over a scheme
entries.definition: Fix a scheme S belonging to a chosen big syntomic site. Use the full subcategory of affine schemes over S, with the standard syntomic coverings inherited from the big slice.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Size-bounded big fppf site
entries.definition: Start with a set of schemes and a set of fppf coverings among them. Enlarge to a Stacks category of schemes closed under the prescribed constructions and choose a set of covering families with the refinement and closure properties in the Stacks construction.
refs: Stacks 021R · Construction from starting objects and coverings

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Size-bounded big ph site
entries.definition: Start with a set of schemes and a set of ph coverings among them. Enlarge to a Stacks category of schemes closed under the prescribed constructions and choose a set of covering families with the refinement and closure properties in the Stacks construction.
refs: Stacks 0DBJ · Construction from starting objects and coverings

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Big ph site over a scheme
entries.definition: Fix a scheme S belonging to a chosen big ph site. Form the slice over S with its inherited covering families.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Big affine ph site over a scheme
entries.definition: Fix a scheme S belonging to a chosen big ph site. Use the full subcategory of affine schemes over S, with the finite ph coverings by affine schemes inherited from the big slice.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Restriction to the small Zariski site
entries.definition: Choose a big Zariski site containing S. Restrict a sheaf on the big slice to its values on objects of the small site. This functor is the inverse image of the small-to-big geometric morphism.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Restriction to the small étale site
entries.definition: Choose a big étale site containing S. Restrict a sheaf on the big slice to its values on objects of the small site. This functor is the inverse image of the small-to-big geometric morphism.

entries.subject: scheme-presheaf-family
entries.name: Descent for a fixed scheme family
entries.definition: Fix a presheaf of sets on schemes and a family with common target. Every choice of sections over the members that agrees on each pairwise fibre product comes from a unique section over the target.

entries.subject: scheme-presheaf
entries.name: Sheaf condition for all fpqc coverings
entries.definition: The contravariant functor from schemes to sets has unique gluing for every matching family for every fpqc covering.

entries.subject: scheme-presheaf
entries.name: Sheaf condition for all V coverings
entries.definition: The contravariant functor from schemes to sets has unique gluing for every matching family for every V covering.

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Flatness of every arrow
entries.definition: Each member of the given family is a flat morphism.

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Finite affine image lifting
entries.definition: Every affine open of the target is exactly the union of the images of finitely many affine opens chosen from domains of the family.
refs: Vistoli, §2.3.2, Proposition 2.33(i)–(ii), Definition 2.34 and the paragraph after Proposition 2.35, pp. 29–30

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Joint surjectivity
entries.definition: The union of the images of all members is the whole target.

entries.subject: scheme-cover-family
entries.name: Local finite presentation of every arrow
entries.definition: Each member is locally of finite presentation.

entries.subject: site-semirepresentable
entries.name: Semi-representable object
entries.definition: An object of $\mathrm{SR}(C)$ is a set-indexed family of objects of a category $C$.
refs: Stacks 01G0 · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.subject: site-semirepresentable
entries.name: Morphism of semi-representable families
entries.definition: A map $(U_i)_{i\in I}\to(V_j)_{j\in J}$ consists of $a:I\to J$ and a map $U_i\to V_{a(i)}$ for every $i$. The index map is part of the data.
refs: Stacks 01G0 · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.subject: site-semirepresentable
entries.name: Semi-representable object over a fixed object
entries.definition: An object of $\mathrm{SR}(C,X)=\mathrm{SR}(C/X)$ is a family of arrows to $X$. Each component of a morphism commutes with the augmentations to $X$.
refs: Stacks 01G0 · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.subject: site-semirepresentable
entries.name: Presheaf of a semi-representable family
entries.definition: The functor $F$ sends $(U_i)$ to the presheaf coproduct $\coprod_i h_{U_i}$. On a test object $T$, its values are the disjoint union of the sets of maps $T\to U_i$.
refs: Stacks 01G1 · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.subject: site-semirepresentable
entries.name: Covering of semi-representable families
entries.definition: For every target index $j$, the component arrows $U_i\to V_j$ indexed by $a(i)=j$ must form a covering family in the specified site.
refs: Stacks 01G3 · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.subject: site-semirepresentable
entries.name: Covering of families over an object
entries.definition: A map in $\mathrm{SR}(C/X)$ is a covering when its underlying map of families in $C$ is a covering.
refs: Stacks 01G3 · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Augmented simplicial families over a site object
entries.subject: site-object-augmented-family
entries.name: Hypercover of an object of a site
entries.definition: For a site $C$ with fibre products, this is a simplicial family over $X$ whose degree-zero augmentation and all relative matching maps are coverings in the specified site.
refs: Stacks 01G5 · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Augmented simplicial families over a site object
entries.subject: site-object-augmented-family
entries.name: Degree-zero covering of an object
entries.definition: The indexed family $K_0$ covers $X$ in the specified site.
refs: Stacks 01G5 · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Augmented simplicial families over a site object
entries.subject: site-object-augmented-family
entries.name: Positive matching covers over an object
entries.definition: For every $n\ge0$, $K_{n+1}\to M_{n+1}K$ is a covering of families, where $M_{n+1}K=(\operatorname{cosk}_n\operatorname{sk}_nK)_{n+1}$ in families over $X$.
refs: Stacks 01G5 · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Augmented simplicial families over a site object
entries.subject: site-object-augmented-family
entries.name: Čech hypercover of a covering family
entries.definition: Up to augmented simplicial isomorphism this is the relative $0$-coskeleton of a specified family covering $X$.
refs: Stacks 01G6 · numbered Stacks source and proof
Dugger–Hollander–Isaksen, Hypercovers and simplicial presheaves, Definition 4.10 and Lemma 4.11, height-zero hypercovers
Stacks 01G6 · Čech hypercover built from a covering family

entries.topic: Simplicial families augmented over a presheaf
entries.subject: site-presheaf-augmented-family
entries.name: Homology sheaves of a simplicial presheaf
entries.definition: Apply the free abelian presheaf functor degreewise, sheafify, and take the homology sheaves of the chain complex with alternating face differential.
refs: Stacks 01GB · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Simplicial families augmented over a presheaf
entries.subject: site-presheaf-augmented-family
entries.name: Verdier hypercover of a presheaf
entries.definition: Over a site with equalizers and fibre products, a simplicial semi-representable family augmented to a presheaf $G$ is a Verdier hypercover if its augmentation and all relative matching maps under $F$ are epimorphisms after sheafification.
refs: Stacks 09VU · numbered Stacks source and proof
Dugger–Hollander–Isaksen, Hypercovers and simplicial presheaves, Definitions 4.2 and 4.8, Lemma 4.9 (local-epimorphism convention)
Stacks 09VU · augmented hypercover of a presheaf

entries.topic: Simplicial families augmented over a presheaf
entries.subject: site-presheaf-augmented-family
entries.name: Locally surjective augmentation
entries.definition: The map $F(K_0)\to G$ is an epimorphism after sheafification.
refs: Stacks 09VU · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Simplicial families augmented over a presheaf
entries.subject: site-presheaf-augmented-family
entries.name: Local lifting of matching pairs
entries.definition: The map $F(K_1)\to F(K_0)\times_G F(K_0)$ is an epimorphism after sheafification.
refs: Stacks 09VU · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Simplicial families augmented over a presheaf
entries.subject: site-presheaf-augmented-family
entries.name: Local lifting of higher boundaries
entries.definition: For each $n\ge1$ the map $F(K_{n+1})\to F((\operatorname{cosk}_n\operatorname{sk}_n K)_{n+1})$ is an epimorphism after sheafification.
refs: Stacks 09VU · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Simplicial families augmented over a presheaf
entries.subject: site-presheaf-augmented-family
entries.name: Hypercover of a site
entries.definition: This is a Verdier hypercover augmented to the terminal presheaf of sets. The site itself need not have a terminal object.
refs: Stacks 09VU · numbered Stacks source and proof
Stacks 09VU · hypercover of the terminal presheaf

entries.topic: Simplicial families augmented over a presheaf
entries.subject: site-presheaf-augmented-family
entries.name: Čech cohomology of an augmented simplicial family
entries.definition: In degree $p$ take the product of the values of the abelian coefficient presheaf on the members of $K_p$. The alternating face differential makes this a cochain complex; its cohomology is $\check H^p(K,-)$.
refs: Stacks 01GY · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Augmented simplicial families over a site object
entries.subject: site-object-augmented-family
entries.name: Cohomology colimit over hypercovers
entries.definition: Take the colimit of $\check H^i(K,\mathcal F)$ over the opposite of the category of hypercovers of $X$ with maps up to homotopy; refinements induce pullback.
refs: Stacks 01H0 · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Simplicial families with a specified truncation bound
entries.subject: site-simplicial-family
entries.name: Split simplicial family
entries.definition: For each degree there is a nondegenerate summand such that the coproduct of its degeneracies, indexed by the ordinal surjections onto lower degrees including the identity, maps isomorphically to that degree.
refs: Stacks 0DAU · numbered Stacks source and proof
Dugger–Hollander–Isaksen, Hypercovers and simplicial presheaves, Definition 4.13, split simplicial objects

entries.topic: Simplicial families with a specified truncation bound
entries.subject: site-simplicial-family
entries.name: Component isomorphisms for every degeneracy composite
entries.definition: In a simplicial family truncated at $r$ (allow $r=\infty$), every component arrow induced by every surjection $[m]\twoheadrightarrow[n]$ with $0\le n\le m\le r$ is an isomorphism.
refs: Stacks 0DAU · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Simplicial families with a specified truncation bound
entries.subject: site-simplicial-family
entries.name: Component isomorphisms for elementary degeneracies
entries.definition: Every component arrow belonging to $s_j:K_n\to K_{n+1}$ with $0\le j\le n<r$ is an isomorphism, for the given finite or infinite truncation bound.
refs: Stacks 0DAU · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Augmented simplicial families over a site object
entries.subject: site-object-augmented-family
entries.name: Hypercover relative to a class of arrows
entries.definition: For a class $P$ closed under composition and base change and containing all isomorphisms in a category with fibre products, an augmented simplicial object is a $P$-hypercover if all relative matching maps, including the degree-zero augmentation, lie in $P$.
refs: Stacks 0DER · numbered Stacks source and proof

entries.topic: Augmented simplicial families over a site object
entries.subject: site-object-augmented-family
entries.name: Higher homotopy lifting question for hypercover refinements
entries.definition: The remark asks whether an arbitrary $K\times\partial\Delta[m]\to L$ of the indicated kind extends to $K^\prime\times\Delta[m]\to L$ after refining $K$ by $K^\prime$. It offers this as an expectation; the proved two-map homotopy statement is Tag 01GS.
refs: Stacks 01GT · numbered Stacks source and proof
Stacks 01GT · conjectural higher extension, recorded as a question

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Presheaf of sets on a space
entries.definition: A contravariant functor from the poset of open subsets of a space $X$ to sets. Its restriction maps respect identities and composition.
refs: R. Vakil, The Rising Sea, 2.2.A and §2.3.3

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Morphism of presheaves of sets
entries.definition: A family of maps on sections, one for each open of the fixed space, commuting with all restrictions.
refs: R. Vakil, The Rising Sea, 2.2.A and §2.3.3

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Category of presheaves of sets
entries.definition: The functor category $\operatorname{Fun}(\operatorname{Open}(X)^{\rm op},\mathbf{Set})$ with natural transformations.
refs: R. Vakil, The Rising Sea, 2.2.A and §2.3.3

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Constant presheaf
entries.definition: For a set $A$, assign $A$ to every open, including the empty open, and the identity map to every restriction.
refs: Stacks 006F · constant presheaf on all opens

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Presheaf of abelian groups
entries.definition: It assigns an abelian group to each open and a group homomorphism to each restriction, functorially.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Morphism of abelian presheaves
entries.definition: A natural transformation of the underlying presheaves whose components are group homomorphisms.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Category of abelian presheaves
entries.definition: The category $\operatorname{Fun}(\operatorname{Open}(X)^{\rm op},\mathbf{Ab})$.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Category-valued presheaf
entries.definition: A contravariant functor from the category of opens of $X$ to the given category $\mathcal C$.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Morphism of category-valued presheaves
entries.definition: A family of arrows in $\mathcal C$ between the values on matching opens, natural with respect to restrictions.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Underlying presheaf of sets
entries.definition: Compose a $\mathcal C$-valued presheaf with the specified faithful functor $F:\mathcal C\to\mathbf{Set}$.
refs: Stacks 006O · composition with the faithful functor

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Presheaf of modules
entries.definition: Over a presheaf of rings $\mathcal O$, an abelian presheaf $\mathcal M$ with a natural action inducing an $\mathcal O(U)$-module structure on $\mathcal M(U)$ for every open $U$.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Morphism of presheaves of modules
entries.definition: An additive natural transformation whose component on each open is linear over the ring of sections on that open.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Hom set of presheaves of modules
entries.definition: The set of module-presheaf morphisms from the specified source presheaf to the specified target presheaf on the common ring presheaf.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Category of presheaves of modules
entries.definition: The category $\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal O)$ with module presheaves as objects and sectionwise linear transformations as arrows.

entries.subject: space-presheaf
entries.name: Sheaf condition on a presheaf of sets
entries.definition: On every open cover of every open, each family of sections that agrees on pairwise intersections is the family of restrictions of exactly one section. The empty covering is included.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Morphism of sheaves of sets
entries.definition: A morphism between the underlying presheaves on the same space.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Category of sheaves of sets
entries.definition: The full subcategory of presheaves of sets satisfying the sheaf condition.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Constant sheaf
entries.definition: For a fixed set $A$ its sections over an open $U$ are the locally constant functions $U\to A$, with restriction of functions.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Sheaf of abelian groups
entries.definition: An abelian presheaf whose underlying presheaf of sets satisfies the sheaf condition.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Category of abelian sheaves
entries.definition: The full subcategory of abelian presheaves whose underlying presheaves are sheaves.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Category-valued sheaf
entries.definition: For $\mathcal C$ with small products and each open cover $(U_i)$ of $U$, the map from $\mathcal F(U)$ to $\prod_i\mathcal F(U_i)$ equalizes universally the two restriction maps to $\prod_{i,j}\mathcal F(U_i\cap U_j)$.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Sheaf of modules on a ringed space
entries.definition: A presheaf of $\mathcal O$-modules for a sheaf of rings $\mathcal O$ whose underlying abelian presheaf is a sheaf.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Morphism of sheaves of modules
entries.definition: A morphism of the underlying presheaves of modules.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Hom set of sheaves of modules
entries.definition: The set of module-sheaf morphisms between the two specified module sheaves.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Category of sheaves of modules
entries.definition: The full subcategory $\mathrm{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ of $\mathrm{PMod}(\mathcal O)$ on sheaves of modules.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Stalk of a presheaf
entries.definition: At a point $x$, form the colimit of sections over open neighbourhoods of $x$, with maps induced by restriction to smaller neighbourhoods.

entries.subject: space-presheaf
entries.name: Separated presheaf on a topological space
entries.definition: For every open $U$ the germ map $\mathcal F(U)\to\prod_{x\in U}\mathcal F_x$ is injective.
refs: R. Vakil, The Rising Sea, §2.2.6, identity axiom

entries.topic: Categories with a specified functor to sets
entries.subject: concrete-category
entries.name: Type of algebraic structure
entries.definition: A category $\mathcal C$ equipped with a faithful functor $F$ to sets that reflects isomorphisms, with all small limits and all filtered colimits, both preserved by $F$.

entries.topic: Categories with a specified functor to sets
entries.subject: concrete-category
entries.name: Faithful underlying-set functor
entries.definition: For all objects the induced map on each hom-set is injective.

entries.topic: Categories with a specified functor to sets
entries.subject: concrete-category
entries.name: All small limits in the source category
entries.definition: Every small diagram in the category admits a limit.

entries.topic: Categories with a specified functor to sets
entries.subject: concrete-category
entries.name: Preservation of existing limits
entries.definition: Applying the specified functor to any limiting cone gives a limiting cone of sets.

entries.topic: Categories with a specified functor to sets
entries.subject: concrete-category
entries.name: All filtered colimits in the source category
entries.definition: Every small filtered diagram in the category admits a colimit.

entries.topic: Categories with a specified functor to sets
entries.subject: concrete-category
entries.name: Preservation of existing filtered colimits
entries.definition: Applying the specified functor to a filtered colimiting cocone gives a colimiting cocone of sets.

entries.topic: Categories with a specified functor to sets
entries.subject: concrete-category
entries.name: Conservative underlying-set functor
entries.definition: Every arrow whose image is a bijection is an isomorphism.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Subpresheaf
entries.definition: For each open the sections form a subset of the ambient presheaf sections, and the restrictions are induced.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Subsheaf
entries.definition: A subpresheaf for which both it and the containing presheaf are sheaves.

entries.subject: set-presheaf-morphism
entries.name: Injective morphism of presheaves of sets
entries.definition: Every map on sections over an open is injective.

entries.subject: set-presheaf-morphism
entries.name: Surjective morphism of presheaves of sets
entries.definition: Every map on sections over an open is surjective.

entries.topic: Morphisms of sheaves of sets on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-map
entries.name: Injective morphism of sheaves of sets
entries.definition: Every map on sections over an open is injective.

entries.topic: Morphisms of sheaves of sets on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-map
entries.name: Surjective morphism of sheaves of sets
entries.definition: Every target section has a lift after restriction to each member of some open cover of its domain.

entries.topic: Morphisms of sheaves of sets on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-map
entries.name: Sectionwise surjectivity of a morphism of sheaves
entries.definition: For every open subset the map between the two sets of sections is surjective.

entries.topic: Morphisms of sheaves of sets on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-map
entries.name: Categorical monomorphism of sheaves of sets
entries.definition: The map is a monomorphism in the category of sheaves of sets on the fixed space.

entries.topic: Morphisms of sheaves of sets on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-map
entries.name: Stalkwise injective morphism of sheaves
entries.definition: At every point the induced map on stalks is injective.

entries.topic: Morphisms of sheaves of sets on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-map
entries.name: Categorical epimorphism of sheaves of sets
entries.definition: The map is a epimorphism in the category of sheaves of sets on the fixed space.

entries.topic: Morphisms of sheaves of sets on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-map
entries.name: Stalkwise surjective morphism of sheaves
entries.definition: At every point the induced map on stalks is surjective.

entries.topic: Morphisms of sheaves of sets on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-map
entries.name: Categorical isomorphism of sheaves of sets
entries.definition: The map is a isomorphism in the category of sheaves of sets on the fixed space.

entries.topic: Morphisms of sheaves of sets on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-map
entries.name: Stalkwise bijective morphism of sheaves
entries.definition: At every point the induced map on stalks is bijective.

entries.subject: set-presheaf-morphism
entries.name: Categorical monomorphism of presheaves of sets
entries.definition: The map is a monomorphism in the functor category of presheaves of sets.

entries.subject: set-presheaf-morphism
entries.name: Categorical epimorphism of presheaves of sets
entries.definition: The map is a epimorphism in the functor category of presheaves of sets.

entries.subject: space-presheaf
entries.name: Injective unit of sheafification
entries.definition: For every open, the unit into the sheafification is injective on sections.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Direct image on a continuous map
entries.definition: The direct image assigns $\mathcal F(f^{-1}V)$ to each open $V\subseteq Y$, with restrictions from $\mathcal F$.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Inverse image of a presheaf
entries.definition: For an open $U\subseteq X$ take the directed colimit of $\mathcal G(V)$ over open neighbourhoods $V$ of $f(U)$, ordered by reverse inclusion.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Inverse image of a sheaf of sets
entries.definition: Sheafify the presheaf inverse image along the continuous map.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Map of sheaves over a continuous map
entries.definition: For $f:X\to Y$ and sheaves $\mathcal G$ on $Y$, $\mathcal F$ on $X$, give functions $\mathcal G(V)\to\mathcal F(f^{-1}V)$ natural in all opens $V\subseteq Y$.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Composition of maps over continuous maps
entries.definition: For composable base maps $f,g$ and compatible sheaf maps $\varphi,\psi$ above them in the opposite direction, use $(\varphi\circ\psi)_W=\varphi_{g^{-1}W}\circ\psi_W$.
refs: Stacks 008L · composition over a composite base map

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Ringed space
entries.definition: A topological space $X$ equipped with a sheaf of rings $\mathcal O_X$.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Morphism of ringed spaces
entries.definition: A continuous $f:X\to Y$ equipped with a map of sheaves of rings $\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X$.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Composition of ringed-space morphisms
entries.definition: Compose the underlying continuous maps and compose the structural maps as maps of ring sheaves over those continuous maps in contravariant order.
refs: Stacks 0093 · composition of the continuous and structural maps

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Direct image of modules on ringed spaces
entries.definition: Take the direct image of the abelian sheaf and restrict scalars along $\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X$.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Pullback of modules on ringed spaces
entries.definition: Form $\mathcal O_X\otimes_{f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y} f^{-1}M$ using the structural homomorphism and the sheaf tensor product.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Skyscraper with specified set at a point
entries.definition: Choose a point x and a set A. Push A on the one-point space forward along its inclusion. In the module case the map of ringed spaces is induced by passage to the stalk.

entries.topic: Sheaves of sets on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-sets
entries.name: Skyscraper sheaf of sets
entries.definition: The specified sheaf of sets is isomorphic in its own category to the direct image from a point of some set.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Skyscraper with specified abelian group at a point
entries.definition: Choose a point x and a abelian group A. Push A on the one-point space forward along its inclusion. In the module case the map of ringed spaces is induced by passage to the stalk.

entries.topic: Sheaves of abelian groups on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-abelian
entries.name: Skyscraper sheaf of abelian groups
entries.definition: The specified sheaf of abelian groups is isomorphic in its own category to the direct image from a point of some abelian group.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Skyscraper with specified object in a fixed type of algebraic structure at a point
entries.definition: Choose a point x and a object in a fixed type of algebraic structure A. Push A on the one-point space forward along its inclusion. In the module case the map of ringed spaces is induced by passage to the stalk.

entries.topic: Sheaves of algebraic structures on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-valued
entries.name: Skyscraper sheaf of algebraic structures
entries.definition: The specified sheaf of algebraic structures is isomorphic in its own category to the direct image from a point of some object in a fixed type of algebraic structure.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Skyscraper with specified module over the stalk of the specified ring sheaf at a point
entries.definition: Choose a point x and a module over the stalk of the specified ring sheaf A. Push A on the one-point space forward along its inclusion. In the module case the map of ringed spaces is induced by passage to the stalk.

entries.topic: Sheaves of modules on a topological space
entries.subject: space-sheaf-modules
entries.name: Skyscraper sheaf of modules
entries.definition: The specified sheaf of modules is isomorphic in its own category to the direct image from a point of some module over the stalk of the specified ring sheaf.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Presheaf of sets on a basis
entries.definition: Fix a basis of opens for the topology of a space X. A contravariant functor from the poset of basis elements to sets.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Map of presheaves of sets on a basis
entries.definition: Fix a basis of opens for the topology of a space X. A natural transformation commuting with all restrictions between basis elements.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Sheaf of sets on a basis
entries.definition: Fix a basis of opens for the topology of a space X. For every basis cover of a basis open and every basis cover of each pairwise overlap, a family agreeing on the chosen pieces of every overlap has a unique gluing on the original basis open.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Map of sheaves of sets on a basis
entries.definition: A morphism between their underlying presheaves on the fixed basis.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Structured presheaf on a basis
entries.definition: Fix a basis of opens for the topology of a space X. A contravariant functor on the basis with values in the fixed type of algebraic structure.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Map of structured presheaves on a basis
entries.definition: Fix a basis of opens for the topology of a space X. Morphisms in the value category on each basis open commuting with restrictions.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Underlying presheaf of a structured basis presheaf
entries.definition: Fix a basis of opens for the topology of a space X. Compose the presheaf on the basis with the specified faithful underlying-set functor.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Structured sheaf on a basis
entries.definition: Fix a basis of opens for the topology of a space X. A presheaf with values in the specified type of algebraic structure whose underlying set presheaf is a sheaf on the basis.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Presheaf of modules on a basis
entries.definition: Fix a basis of opens for the topology of a space X. Over a ring presheaf on the basis, an abelian presheaf with a natural action giving a module over the corresponding ring on each basis open.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Map of module presheaves on a basis
entries.definition: Fix a basis of opens for the topology of a space X. An additive transformation that is module-linear over the ring of sections on every basis open.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Sheaf of modules on a basis
entries.definition: Fix a basis of opens for the topology of a space X. Over a ring sheaf on the basis, a module presheaf whose underlying abelian presheaf is a sheaf on the basis.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Restriction of presheaves of sets
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Evaluate the presheaf on opens contained in U with the same restrictions.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Restriction of sheaves of sets
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Evaluate on opens contained in U. The inverse image on sheaves is already computed by that restriction.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Extension of presheaves of sets by the empty set
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Use the original values on opens contained in U and the empty set on every other open. Restrictions leaving an initial value are its unique maps.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Extension of sheaves of sets by the empty set
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Sheafify the presheaf extension by the empty set.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Restriction of presheaves of abelian groups
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Evaluate the presheaf on opens contained in U with the same restrictions.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Restriction of sheaves of abelian groups
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Evaluate on opens contained in U. The inverse image on sheaves is already computed by that restriction.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Extension of presheaves of abelian groups by the zero abelian group
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Use the original values on opens contained in U and the zero abelian group on every other open. Restrictions leaving an initial value are its unique maps.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Extension of sheaves of abelian groups by the zero abelian group
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Sheafify the presheaf extension by the zero abelian group.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Restriction of presheaves of algebraic structures
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Fix a type of algebraic structure. Evaluate the presheaf on opens contained in U with the same restrictions.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Restriction of sheaves of algebraic structures
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Fix a type of algebraic structure. Evaluate on opens contained in U. The inverse image on sheaves is already computed by that restriction.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Extension of presheaves of algebraic structures by the specified initial object
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Fix a category with an initial object. Use the original values on opens contained in U and the specified initial object on every other open. Restrictions leaving an initial value are its unique maps.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Extension of sheaves of algebraic structures by the specified initial object
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Fix a type of algebraic structure. Assume the value category has an initial object. Sheafify the presheaf extension by the specified initial object.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Restriction of presheaves of modules
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Fix a presheaf of rings on X, and use its restriction on U. Evaluate the presheaf on opens contained in U with the same restrictions. Retain the action by the restricted ring presheaf.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Restriction of module sheaves
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Fix a ringed space and use its restricted ring on the open subspace. Take the restriction on sections along with its action by the restricted ring sheaf.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Extension of presheaves of modules by the zero module
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Fix a presheaf of rings on X, and use its restriction on U. Use the original values on opens contained in U and the zero module on every other open. Restrictions leaving an initial value are its unique maps. Use the given scalar action on the opens in U and the unique action on zero modules elsewhere.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Extension of sheaves of modules by the zero module
entries.definition: Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ include an open subset. Fix a ringed space and use its restricted ring on the open subspace. Sheafify the presheaf extension by the zero module, retaining its induced module action.

entries.topic: Operations on sheaves on topological spaces
entries.subject: sheaf-operation
entries.name: Open subspace of a ringed space
entries.definition: For an open $U$ in a ringed space $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ use the pair $(U,\mathcal O_X|_U)$.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: fpqc locality for a scheme property
entries.definition: Use fpqc coverings. For every cover $(S_i\to S)$, $S$ has the property exactly when all the $S_i$ have it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: fppf locality for a scheme property
entries.definition: Use fppf coverings. For every cover $(S_i\to S)$, $S$ has the property exactly when all the $S_i$ have it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: syntomic locality for a scheme property
entries.definition: Use syntomic coverings. For every cover $(S_i\to S)$, $S$ has the property exactly when all the $S_i$ have it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: smooth locality for a scheme property
entries.definition: Use smooth coverings. For every cover $(S_i\to S)$, $S$ has the property exactly when all the $S_i$ have it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: étale locality for a scheme property
entries.definition: Use étale coverings. For every cover $(S_i\to S)$, $S$ has the property exactly when all the $S_i$ have it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Zariski locality for a scheme property
entries.definition: Use Zariski coverings. For every cover $(S_i\to S)$, $S$ has the property exactly when all the $S_i$ have it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: fpqc locality on the target
entries.definition: Use fpqc coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(Y_i\to Y)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every pullback $X\times_Y Y_i\to Y_i$ has it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: fppf locality on the target
entries.definition: Use fppf coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(Y_i\to Y)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every pullback $X\times_Y Y_i\to Y_i$ has it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: syntomic locality on the target
entries.definition: Use syntomic coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(Y_i\to Y)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every pullback $X\times_Y Y_i\to Y_i$ has it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: smooth locality on the target
entries.definition: Use smooth coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(Y_i\to Y)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every pullback $X\times_Y Y_i\to Y_i$ has it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: étale locality on the target
entries.definition: Use étale coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(Y_i\to Y)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every pullback $X\times_Y Y_i\to Y_i$ has it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Zariski locality on the target
entries.definition: Use Zariski coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(Y_i\to Y)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every pullback $X\times_Y Y_i\to Y_i$ has it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: fpqc locality on the source
entries.definition: Use fpqc coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(X_i\to X)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every composite $X_i\to Y$ has it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: fppf locality on the source
entries.definition: Use fppf coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(X_i\to X)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every composite $X_i\to Y$ has it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: syntomic locality on the source
entries.definition: Use syntomic coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(X_i\to X)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every composite $X_i\to Y$ has it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: smooth locality on the source
entries.definition: Use smooth coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(X_i\to X)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every composite $X_i\to Y$ has it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: étale locality on the source
entries.definition: Use étale coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(X_i\to X)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every composite $X_i\to Y$ has it.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Zariski locality on the source
entries.definition: Use Zariski coverings. For each $f:X\to Y$ and cover $(X_i\to X)$, $f$ has the property exactly when every composite $X_i\to Y$ has it.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Jacobson scheme
entries.definition: Every affine open has Jacobson coordinate ring, equivalently every closed subset has dense closed points.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Finitely many irreducible components on quasi-compact opens
entries.definition: Each quasi-compact open subspace has only finitely many irreducible components.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Locally Noetherian scheme satisfying a fixed Serre depth condition
entries.definition: Fix an integer $k\ge0$. The scheme is locally Noetherian and the depth of each local ring is at least the minimum of $k$ and its dimension.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Locally Noetherian scheme regular in a fixed codimension range
entries.definition: Fix an integer $k\ge0$. The scheme is locally Noetherian and each local ring of dimension at most $k$ is regular.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Nagata scheme
entries.definition: Every point admits an affine neighbourhood with Nagata coordinate ring.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Dominant morphism
entries.definition: The image is dense in the target.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Locally quasi-finite morphism
entries.definition: The morphism is locally of finite type and each source point is isolated in its scheme-theoretic fibre.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Locally finite type with specified relative dimension
entries.definition: For a fixed integer $d$, the morphism is locally of finite type and each nonempty fibre is equidimensional of dimension $d$ in the sense of the relative dimension condition.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Finite locally free morphism
entries.definition: The map is affine and its direct image of the structure sheaf is a finite locally free module.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Finite locally free morphism of specified degree
entries.definition: For fixed $d\ge0$ the map is finite locally free and the direct image of its structure sheaf has constant rank $d$.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Koszul-regular immersion
entries.definition: Locally as a closed immersion the defining ideal admits generators forming a Koszul-regular sequence.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: First-Koszul-homology-regular immersion
entries.definition: Locally as a closed immersion its ideal is generated by a finite sequence with vanishing first Koszul homology.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Quasi-regular immersion
entries.definition: Locally as a closed immersion its ideal is generated by a quasi-regular sequence: the conormal module is freely generated by the classes of the sequence and its symmetric algebra maps isomorphically to the associated graded algebra.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Injectivity on every local ring
entries.definition: Every stalk map $\mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is injective.

entries.topic: Germs of schemes and maps of germs
entries.subject: descent-germ
entries.name: Germ of a scheme at a point
entries.definition: The data are a scheme $X$ and a point $x\in X$.

entries.topic: Germs of schemes and maps of germs
entries.subject: descent-germ
entries.name: Morphism of scheme germs
entries.definition: A map $(X,x)\to(S,s)$ is a map defined on an open neighbourhood of $x$ to $S$ carrying $x$ to $s$, modulo equality on a smaller neighbourhood.

entries.topic: Germs of schemes and maps of germs
entries.subject: descent-germ
entries.name: Composition of scheme germ morphisms
entries.definition: Restrict representatives so the image lands in the domain of the second representative and compose. Shrinking either representative gives the same germ.

entries.topic: Germs of schemes and maps of germs
entries.subject: descent-germ
entries.name: étale morphism of germs
entries.definition: There is a representative defined on an open neighbourhood of the marked source point which is étale.

entries.topic: Germs of schemes and maps of germs
entries.subject: descent-germ
entries.name: étale-local property of germs
entries.definition: The property holds for $(U,u)$ exactly when it holds for $(V,v)$ for every étale morphism of pointed germs $(V,v)\to(U,u)$.

entries.topic: Germs of schemes and maps of germs
entries.subject: descent-germ
entries.name: smooth morphism of germs
entries.definition: There is a representative defined on an open neighbourhood of the marked source point which is smooth.

entries.topic: Germs of schemes and maps of germs
entries.subject: descent-germ
entries.name: smooth-local property of germs
entries.definition: The property holds for $(U,u)$ exactly when it holds for $(V,v)$ for every smooth morphism of pointed germs $(V,v)\to(U,u)$.

entries.topic: Quasi-coherent descent data over a family
entries.subject: descent-sheaf-data
entries.name: Descent datum for quasi-coherent modules
entries.definition: Fix a family of scheme maps $(X_i\to S)$. It consists of a quasi-coherent module on each $X_i$ and isomorphisms between the two pullbacks on each double overlap. On every triple overlap the composite of the pulled-back transitions $01$ and $12$ equals the pulled-back transition $02$.

entries.topic: Quasi-coherent descent data over a family
entries.subject: descent-sheaf-data
entries.name: Triple-overlap cocycle for modules
entries.definition: Fix a family of scheme maps $(X_i\to S)$. On every triple overlap the composite of the pulled-back transitions $01$ and $12$ equals the pulled-back transition $02$.

entries.topic: Quasi-coherent descent data over a family
entries.subject: descent-sheaf-data
entries.name: Compatible maps of quasi-coherent descent data
entries.definition: Fix a family of scheme maps $(X_i\to S)$. Each component map over $X_i$ commutes with the transition isomorphisms after the two pullbacks to every double overlap.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Descent datum for a family of schemes
entries.definition: Fix a family of scheme maps $(X_i\to S)$. It consists of an $X_i$-scheme for each $i$ and isomorphisms between the two pullbacks on each double overlap. On every triple overlap the composite of the pulled-back transitions $01$ and $12$ equals the pulled-back transition $02$.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Triple-overlap cocycle for schemes
entries.definition: Fix a family of scheme maps $(X_i\to S)$. On every triple overlap the composite of the pulled-back transitions $01$ and $12$ equals the pulled-back transition $02$.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Compatible maps of scheme descent data
entries.definition: Fix a family of scheme maps $(X_i\to S)$. Each component map over $X_i$ commutes with the transition isomorphisms after the two pullbacks to every double overlap.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Descent transition for a specified scheme
entries.definition: $V\to X\to S$ is fixed. A transition is an isomorphism $V\times_S X\simeq X\times_S V$ over $X\times_S X$ satisfying the triple-overlap cocycle.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Descent datum over a single scheme map
entries.definition: For $X\to S$, the datum consists of an $X$-scheme together with a transition over the double fibre product satisfying the triple-overlap cocycle.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Morphism of descent data over a single map
entries.definition: A map of the underlying $X$-schemes must commute with their two pulled-back transitions over $X\times_S X$.

entries.topic: Quasi-coherent descent data over a family
entries.subject: descent-sheaf-data
entries.name: Trivial qc descent datum
entries.definition: Over the identity family the transition on a quasi-coherent module over the base is the identity.

entries.topic: Quasi-coherent descent data over a family
entries.subject: descent-sheaf-data
entries.name: Canonical qc descent datum
entries.definition: The pullbacks of the module over the covering objects carry the canonical isomorphisms induced by their common pullback from the base.

entries.topic: Quasi-coherent descent data over a family
entries.subject: descent-sheaf-data
entries.name: Effective qc descent datum
entries.definition: There exists a quasi-coherent module over the base whose canonical datum is isomorphic, with its transitions, to the specified datum.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Trivial single descent datum
entries.definition: Over the identity family the transition on a scheme over the base is the identity.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Canonical single descent datum
entries.definition: The fibre products of the scheme over the covering objects carry the canonical isomorphisms induced by their common pullback from the base.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Effective single descent datum
entries.definition: There exists a scheme over the base whose canonical datum is isomorphic, with its transitions, to the specified datum.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Canonical scheme descent datum
entries.definition: The fibre products of the scheme over the covering objects carry the canonical isomorphisms induced by their common pullback from the base.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Effective scheme descent datum
entries.definition: There exists a scheme over the base whose canonical datum is isomorphic, with its transitions, to the specified datum.

entries.topic: Module descent data over a ring map
entries.subject: descent-module-data
entries.name: Module descent datum
entries.definition: Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative unital rings. An $A$-module $N$ has an $A\otimes_R A$-linear isomorphism $N\otimes_R A\simeq A\otimes_R N$ satisfying the cocycle over the triple tensor product.

entries.topic: Module descent data over a ring map
entries.subject: descent-module-data
entries.name: Cocycle of a module descent transition
entries.definition: Over $A\otimes_R A\otimes_R A$ the change of factor from the first to the third equals the change from the first to the second followed by that from the second to the third.

entries.topic: Module descent data over a ring map
entries.subject: descent-module-data
entries.name: Morphism of module descent data
entries.definition: An $A$-linear map $u:N\to N^\prime$ intertwines the transitions: $(1\otimes u)\varphi=\varphi^\prime(u\otimes1)$.

entries.topic: Module descent data over a ring map
entries.subject: descent-module-data
entries.name: Effective module descent datum
entries.definition: Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative unital rings. Some $R$-module $M$ has canonical datum on $A\otimes_R M$ isomorphic to the specified datum.

entries.topic: Module descent data over a ring map
entries.subject: descent-module-data
entries.name: Cosimplicial module of descent data
entries.definition: Let $R\to A$ be a homomorphism of commutative unital rings. In degree $n$ use $A^{\otimes_R n}\otimes_R N$ with $N$ in the last slot. For an ordinal map pull along the tensor-power map and transport the distinguished slot to the last one by the transition.

entries.topic: Module descent data over a ring map
entries.subject: descent-module-data
entries.name: Split equalizer
entries.definition: For $A\xrightarrow fB\rightrightarrows^{g_1}_{g_2} C$ with $g_1f=g_2f$, there exist $h:B\to A$ and $i:C\to B$ with $hf=1$, $fh=ig_1$ and $ig_2=1$.

entries.topic: Module descent data over a ring map
entries.subject: descent-module-data
entries.name: Contravariant character module
entries.definition: Write $C(M)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathbb Z}(M,\mathbb Q/\mathbb Z)$, with $(r\lambda)(m)=\lambda(rm)$. On maps use precomposition.

entries.subject: ring-map
entries.name: Base extension into module descent data
entries.definition: For $R\to S$, send $M$ to $S\otimes_R M$ with its canonical transition.

entries.subject: ring-map
entries.name: Descent morphism for modules
entries.definition: Base extension into the category of descent data is fully faithful.

entries.subject: ring-map
entries.name: Effective descent morphism for modules
entries.definition: Base extension into the category of descent data is an equivalence.

entries.topic: Module descent data over a ring map
entries.subject: descent-module-data
entries.name: Invariant module of descent data
entries.definition: For datum $(M,\theta)$ on $R\to S$, take the $R$-submodule of $M$ where the two maps into its pullback over $S\otimes_R S$ coincide. One map transports across $\theta$ and the other is ordinary extension from the other factor.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Pullback functor on descent data over one map
entries.definition: Fix a commuting square of scheme maps with upper arrow $f:X^\prime\to X$ and lower arrow $h:S^\prime\to S$. For data relative to $X\to S$ pull the underlying scheme back by $f$ and the transition back over the twofold product; the result is relative to $X^\prime\to S^\prime$.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Pullback functor on scheme descent data over a family
entries.definition: Fix families $(U_i\to S^\prime),(V_j\to S)$ and a compatible morphism between them over $h:S^\prime\to S$, consisting of an index map $a$ and maps $g_i:U_i\to V_{a(i)}$. Apply $g_i^*$ to the object with index $a(i)$ and pull each transition back by the induced map of overlaps.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Descent of morphisms of a fixed type for fpqc covers
entries.definition: For any fpqc cover of $S$, every scheme descent datum whose component structure maps have the specified property $P$ must be effective.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Descent of morphisms of a fixed type for fppf covers
entries.definition: For any fppf cover of $S$, every scheme descent datum whose component structure maps have the specified property $P$ must be effective.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Descent of morphisms of a fixed type for syntomic covers
entries.definition: For any syntomic cover of $S$, every scheme descent datum whose component structure maps have the specified property $P$ must be effective.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Descent of morphisms of a fixed type for smooth covers
entries.definition: For any smooth cover of $S$, every scheme descent datum whose component structure maps have the specified property $P$ must be effective.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Descent of morphisms of a fixed type for étale covers
entries.definition: For any étale cover of $S$, every scheme descent datum whose component structure maps have the specified property $P$ must be effective.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Descent of morphisms of a fixed type for Zariski covers
entries.definition: For any Zariski cover of $S$, every scheme descent datum whose component structure maps have the specified property $P$ must be effective.

entries.topic: Modules on scheme sites and comparison functors
entries.subject: descent-ringed-site
entries.name: Structure sheaf on a big scheme site
entries.definition: Fix a scheme $S$ and the big scheme site over $S$ for the Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic or fppf topology. Its values on $T$ are the ring $\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$.

entries.topic: Modules on scheme sites and comparison functors
entries.subject: descent-ringed-site
entries.name: Structure sheaf on a small scheme site
entries.definition: Fix a scheme $S$ and its small Zariski or small étale site. It sends $T$ to the ring of regular functions on $T$.

entries.topic: Modules on scheme sites and comparison functors
entries.subject: descent-ringed-site
entries.name: Associated quasi-coherent module on the big site
entries.definition: Fix a scheme $S$ and the big scheme site over $S$ for the Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic or fppf topology. For a quasi-coherent $F$ on $S$, the associated sheaf $F^a$ evaluates on $t:T\to S$ as $\Gamma(T,t^*F)$.

entries.topic: Modules on scheme sites and comparison functors
entries.subject: descent-ringed-site
entries.name: Associated quasi-coherent module on the small site
entries.definition: Fix a scheme $S$ and its small Zariski or small étale site. For a quasi-coherent $F$ on $S$, the associated sheaf $F^a$ evaluates on $t:T\to S$ as $\Gamma(T,t^*F)$.

entries.topic: Modules on scheme sites and comparison functors
entries.subject: descent-ringed-site
entries.name: Parasitic module presheaf
entries.definition: Fix a scheme $S$ and the big scheme site over $S$ for the Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic or fppf topology. A presheaf of modules is parasitic if it has zero sections on every $U$ flat over $S$.

entries.topic: Modules on scheme sites and comparison functors
entries.subject: descent-ringed-site
entries.name: Parasitic module presheaf for a topology
entries.definition: Fix a scheme $S$ and the big scheme site over $S$ for the Zariski, étale, smooth, syntomic or fppf topology. For the fixed topology, the presheaf has zero sections on each member of every covering family of $S$.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Universally effective epimorphic family in affine schemes
entries.definition: For a family of affine schemes over an affine target, after every affine base change maps out of the new target are the equalizer of compatible maps on members and double overlaps, for each affine test target.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Universally effective epimorphic family in schemes
entries.definition: After every scheme base change, maps from the new target to any test scheme correspond bijectively to compatible maps on the covering objects.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Étale locality on source and target
entries.definition: For each commuting scheme square with étale vertical maps, require stability under étale precomposition and base change and the following recognition test: $f$ has $P$ precisely when at every $x\in X$ there is such a square and a lift $u$ with $a(u)=x$ where $h$ has $P$.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Stability under étale precomposition
entries.definition: Precomposing an arrow with $P$ by any étale map yields another arrow with $P$.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Stability under étale base change
entries.definition: The pullback of any $P$-arrow by an étale target map has $P$.

entries.topic: Locality of properties under specified scheme covers
entries.subject: descent-locality
entries.name: Pointwise recognition using étale squares
entries.definition: Write a commuting square with horizontal $h:U\to V$, $f:X\to Y$ and vertical $a:U\to X$, $b:V\to Y$; it need not be cartesian. For each $f$, $P(f)$ is equivalent to existence, for every $x\in X$, of a square with étale $a,b$ and $u$ over $x$ such that $P(h)$.

entries.topic: Germs of schemes and maps of germs
entries.subject: descent-germ
entries.name: Étale locality for properties of germ morphisms
entries.definition: In every commuting square of scheme germs with étale vertical maps, the indicated property holds for the upper map exactly when it holds for the lower map.
refs: Stacks 04NB · invariance of a property of morphisms of germs

entries.topic: Families of open immersions over a scheme
entries.subject: descent-cover-family
entries.name: Jointly covering family of open immersions
entries.definition: The images of the specified open immersions have union equal to the common target.

entries.topic: Families of open immersions over a scheme
entries.subject: descent-cover-family
entries.name: Coproduct map is an open immersion
entries.definition: The natural arrow from the scheme coproduct of the specified opens to the common target is an open immersion.

entries.topic: Association of quasi-coherent modules to a big scheme site
entries.subject: descent-site-association
entries.name: Right exact association to a big site
entries.definition: The functor sending a quasi-coherent module to its associated big-site module preserves right exact sequences.

entries.topic: Association of quasi-coherent modules to a big scheme site
entries.subject: descent-site-association
entries.name: Left exact association to a big site
entries.definition: The functor sending a quasi-coherent module to its associated big-site module preserves finite limits.

entries.subject: ring-map
entries.name: Unramified local homomorphism in the Noetherian convention
entries.definition: Let $A\to B$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings. The target is essentially of finite type, its maximal ideal is generated by the source maximal ideal, and its residue extension is finite separable. This definition concerns local rings; the unlocalized algebra need not be of finite type.
refs: Grothendieck–Dieudonné, EGA IV₄, 17.4.1 and 17.4.4, under the finite presentation or Noetherian hypotheses there

entries.subject: ring-map
entries.name: Source maximal ideal generates the target maximal ideal
entries.definition: For a local map $(A,\mathfrak m)\to(B,\mathfrak n)$, one has $\mathfrak mB=\mathfrak n$.

entries.subject: ring-map
entries.name: Finite separable residue extension of a local map
entries.definition: For the specified local ring homomorphism the induced extension of residue fields is finite and separable.

entries.subject: ring-map
entries.name: Étale local homomorphism in the Noetherian convention
entries.definition: Let $A\to B$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings. The map is flat and unramified in the local-ring sense of Tag 024M.
refs: Grothendieck–Dieudonné, EGA IV₄, 17.6.1 and 17.6.3, local and completed étale criteria

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Formally unramified morphism of schemes
entries.definition: For every affine scheme $T$ over the target and square-zero closed immersion $T_0\hookrightarrow T$, restriction of target-relative maps to the source is injective.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Every fibre is empty or the residue-field point
entries.definition: For every target point $s$, the fibre is empty or its structure morphism to $\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ is an isomorphism.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Quotient map on underlying Zariski spaces
entries.definition: The map is surjective and a subset of its target is open exactly when its inverse image is open.

entries.subject: morphism
entries.name: Formally étale morphism of schemes
entries.definition: For every affine scheme $T$ over the target and every square-zero closed subscheme $T_0$ of $T$, restriction gives a bijection on maps from $T$ and $T_0$ over the target.

entries.topic: Closed subschemes of locally Noetherian schemes
entries.subject: etale-closed-subscheme
entries.name: Effective Cartier divisor on a locally Noetherian ambient scheme
entries.definition: Fix a locally Noetherian scheme $X$ and a closed subscheme $D\subseteq X$. The ideal of $D$ is locally generated by one nonzerodivisor.

entries.topic: Closed subschemes of locally Noetherian schemes
entries.subject: etale-closed-subscheme
entries.name: Ambient regularity along the divisor
