entries.definition: Fix a locally Noetherian scheme $X$ and a closed subscheme $D\subseteq X$. Each $\mathcal O_{X,p}$ for $p\in D$ is regular. The condition only refers to points on $D$.
refs: Stacks 0BI9 · (regular local ambient rings at points on D)

entries.topic: Closed subschemes of locally Noetherian schemes
entries.subject: etale-closed-subscheme
entries.name: Equation given by distinct regular parameters
entries.definition: Fix a locally Noetherian scheme $X$ and a closed subscheme $D\subseteq X$. At every $p$ of $D$ the local ideal is generated by a product of $r\ge1$ different members of a regular system of parameters in the regular local ambient ring at $p$.

entries.topic: Closed subschemes of locally Noetherian schemes
entries.subject: etale-closed-subscheme
entries.name: Strict normal crossings divisor
entries.definition: Fix a locally Noetherian scheme $X$ and a closed subscheme $D\subseteq X$. An effective Cartier divisor which, at every point of its support, is cut out in a regular local ring by a product of distinct members of one regular system of parameters.

entries.topic: Closed subschemes of locally Noetherian schemes
entries.subject: etale-closed-subscheme
entries.name: Regular ambient scheme
entries.definition: Fix a locally Noetherian scheme $X$ and a closed subscheme $D\subseteq X$. Every local ring of the ambient scheme is regular.

entries.topic: Closed subschemes of locally Noetherian schemes
entries.subject: etale-closed-subscheme
entries.name: Reduced closed subscheme
entries.definition: Fix a locally Noetherian scheme $X$ and a closed subscheme $D\subseteq X$. The closed subscheme $D$ is reduced.

entries.topic: Closed subschemes of locally Noetherian schemes
entries.subject: etale-closed-subscheme
entries.name: Effective Cartier irreducible components
entries.definition: Fix a locally Noetherian scheme $X$ and a closed subscheme $D\subseteq X$. Every irreducible component of $D$ with its reduced induced structure is an effective Cartier divisor on $X$.

entries.topic: Closed subschemes of locally Noetherian schemes
entries.subject: etale-closed-subscheme
entries.name: Regular intersections of distinct components
entries.definition: Fix a locally Noetherian scheme $X$ and a closed subscheme $D\subseteq X$. For each finite nonempty collection of distinct reduced components of $D$, their scheme-theoretic intersection in $X$ is regular.

entries.topic: Closed subschemes of locally Noetherian schemes
entries.subject: etale-closed-subscheme
entries.name: Expected codimension for intersections of components
entries.definition: Fix a locally Noetherian scheme $X$ and a closed subscheme $D\subseteq X$. For each nonempty finite set of $r$ distinct reduced components, every irreducible component of their scheme-theoretic intersection has codimension $r$ in $X$.

entries.topic: Closed subschemes of locally Noetherian schemes
entries.subject: etale-closed-subscheme
entries.name: Normal crossings divisor
entries.definition: Fix a locally Noetherian scheme $X$ and a closed subscheme $D\subseteq X$. An effective Cartier divisor such that every point of its support is in the image of an étale $U\to X$ for which the entire pullback is a strict normal crossings divisor on $U$.

entries.topic: Closed subschemes of locally Noetherian schemes
entries.subject: etale-closed-subscheme
entries.name: Étale-local strict normal crossings models
entries.definition: Fix a locally Noetherian scheme $X$ and a closed subscheme $D\subseteq X$. For each point of $D$, an étale map from a scheme with that point in its image pulls $D$ back to a strict normal crossings divisor.
refs: Stacks 0BSF · existence of étale-local strict models

entries.subject: ring-map
entries.name: Ring homomorphism with reduced source
entries.definition: The source ring of the specified homomorphism is reduced.

entries.subject: ring-map
entries.name: Ring homomorphism with reduced target
entries.definition: The target ring of the specified homomorphism is reduced.

entries.topic: Descent data for schemes over a family
entries.subject: descent-scheme-data
entries.name: Pullback to descent data on étale schemes
entries.definition: For $f:X\to S$, let $D_f$ take an étale $S$-scheme to the canonical descent datum on its pullback to $X$. The descent isomorphism identifies both pullbacks with the same fibre product over $S$ and satisfies the cocycle identity on the triple fibre product.

entries.name: Presheaf of sets on a category
entries.definition: A functor $\mathcal C^{\rm op}\to\mathbf{Set}$.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Morphism of presheaves on a category
entries.definition: A natural transformation of the specified contravariant set-valued functors.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Category of presheaves on a category
entries.definition: The functor category of set-valued contravariant functors and natural transformations.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Presheaf on a category with specified values
entries.definition: For categories $\mathcal C,\mathcal A$, a functor $\mathcal C^{\rm op}\to\mathcal A$.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Map of presheaves with specified values
entries.definition: A natural transformation with components in the given value category.
entries.subject: site

entries.topic: Morphisms of set-valued presheaves on a small category
entries.name: Objectwise injective morphism of presheaves
entries.definition: The function on sections at every object is injective.
entries.subject: category-presheaf-arrow

entries.topic: Morphisms of set-valued presheaves on a small category
entries.name: Objectwise surjective morphism of presheaves
entries.definition: The function on sections at every object is surjective.
entries.subject: category-presheaf-arrow

entries.name: Subpresheaf on a category
entries.definition: A subset of sections at each object, preserved by restrictions with the induced restriction functions.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Image subpresheaf
entries.definition: The subpresheaf of the target whose value at each object is the image of the component function.
entries.subject: site

entries.topic: Morphisms of set-valued presheaves on a small category
entries.name: Categorical monomorphism in presheaves
entries.definition: The given presheaf map is a monomorphism in the presheaf category.
entries.subject: category-presheaf-arrow

entries.topic: Morphisms of set-valued presheaves on a small category
entries.name: Categorical epimorphism in presheaves
entries.definition: The given presheaf map is a epimorphism in the presheaf category.
entries.subject: category-presheaf-arrow

entries.topic: Morphisms of set-valued presheaves on a small category
entries.name: Categorical isomorphism in presheaves
entries.definition: The given presheaf map is a isomorphism in the presheaf category.
entries.subject: category-presheaf-arrow

entries.name: Family of arrows with fixed target
entries.definition: Specify an object $U$, a set $I$, and for each $i\in I$ an arrow $U_i\to U$. Repeated arrows retain their indices.
entries.subject: site

entries.topic: Small categories with a specified set of indexed families
entries.name: Isomorphism covers
entries.definition: Every isomorphism, taken as a singleton family, belongs to the specified set of covering families.
entries.subject: category-coverage

entries.topic: Small categories with a specified set of indexed families
entries.name: Composition of covers
entries.definition: Given a cover of an object and a chosen cover of each source, the indexed composite family is in the specified set.
entries.subject: category-coverage

entries.topic: Small categories with a specified set of indexed families
entries.name: Existence of pullbacks of covering arrows
entries.definition: Each arrow of a covering family has a fibre product along every arrow into its target.
entries.subject: category-coverage

entries.topic: Small categories with a specified set of indexed families
entries.name: Base-change stability of cover families
entries.definition: For every cover and base change for which the indicated pullbacks exist, their family is a cover.
entries.subject: category-coverage

entries.topic: Presheaves on a small category with specified topology when needed
entries.name: Sheaf condition for covering families
entries.definition: For each cover $(U_i\to U)$, sections on $U$ identify with tuples of sections on $U_i$ with equal restrictions to every $U_i\times_U U_j$.
entries.subject: category-presheaf

entries.name: Category of sheaves of sets on a site
entries.definition: The full subcategory of presheaves whose objects satisfy the covering-family sheaf axiom.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Sheaf with values in a category on a site
entries.definition: For every test object T of the value category, applying Hom(T,−) to the presheaf produces a sheaf of sets.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Sieve generated by an indexed family
entries.definition: It consists of the arrows to the fixed target that factor through at least one member of the family.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Pullback of a sieve
entries.definition: For $f:V\to U$ and $S\subset h_U$, the sieve $f^*S$ consists of arrows $g$ to $V$ with $fg\in S$.
entries.subject: site

entries.topic: Small categories with a specified assignment of sieves
entries.name: Stability of covering sieves under pullback
entries.definition: Pulling a designated covering sieve back along any arrow gives a covering sieve.
entries.subject: category-sieve-assignment

entries.topic: Small categories with a specified assignment of sieves
entries.name: Local character of covering sieves
entries.definition: If a sieve pulls back to a covering sieve along every arrow of one covering sieve on the same target, then it covers.
entries.subject: category-sieve-assignment

entries.topic: Small categories with a specified assignment of sieves
entries.name: Maximal sieves cover
entries.definition: The maximal sieve on each object is covering.
entries.subject: category-sieve-assignment

entries.topic: Ordered pairs of topologies on one small category
entries.name: First topology finer than the second
entries.definition: For a pair (J,K) on one category, every K-covering sieve is J-covering. Equivalently K is coarser than J.
entries.subject: category-topology-pair
refs: Stacks 00Z6 · order and its opposite terminology

entries.topic: Presheaves on a small category with specified topology when needed
entries.name: Sheaf condition for covering sieves
entries.definition: For every $S\in J(U)$ the map $F(U)=\operatorname{Hom}(h_U,F)\to\operatorname{Hom}(S,F)$ is bijective.
entries.subject: category-presheaf
refs: Stacks 00Z8 · sheaf for a sieve topology

entries.topic: Presheaves on a small category with specified topology when needed
entries.name: Separated presheaf for a sieve topology
entries.definition: For every covering sieve $S$ on $U$, restriction $F(U)\to\operatorname{Hom}(S,F)$ is injective.
entries.subject: category-presheaf
refs: Stacks 00ZI · separated for a sieve topology

entries.name: Sieve topology associated to a covering-family site
entries.definition: A sieve covers if and only if it contains the sieve generated by a covering family of the site.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Plus construction over covering sieves
entries.definition: On $U$ take the colimit of $\operatorname{Hom}(S,F)$ over covering sieves ordered by refinement, using restriction to a smaller sieve for the transition maps.
entries.subject: site

entries.topic: Ordered pairs of topologies on one small category
entries.name: Reverse inclusion of sheaf subcategories
entries.definition: For an ordered pair (J,K) on the same category, every J-sheaf is a K-sheaf in the common presheaf category.
entries.subject: category-topology-pair

entries.topic: Covariant functors from a small site to sets
entries.name: Point of a topology in sieves
entries.definition: For the chosen covariant set functor u, the stalk is the colimit of presheaf sections over the opposite of its category of elements. It must be exact on sheaves and take every covering-sieve inclusion into its representable to a surjection.
entries.subject: site-set-functor

entries.topic: Covariant functors from a small site to sets
entries.name: Covering-sieve surjectivity at a functor
entries.definition: For each covering sieve the inclusion into the corresponding representable induces a surjection on the stalks defined by the chosen functor.
entries.subject: site-set-functor

entries.topic: Covariant functors from a small site to sets
entries.name: Exactness of the stalk on sheaves
entries.definition: The stalk defined by the chosen functor preserves finite limits and finite colimits on sheaves.
entries.subject: site-set-functor

entries.name: Left Kan extension of presheaves along a functor
entries.definition: For $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, the value of $u_p F$ at $V$ is the colimit of $F(U)$ over the opposite of $(V\downarrow u)$.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Precomposition of presheaves along a functor
entries.definition: For $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, put $(u^pG)(U)=G(uU)$.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Morphism between indexed families of arrows
entries.definition: Choose an arrow between targets, a function between index sets, and a map from each source to its matched source commuting with the arrows to the targets.
entries.subject: site

entries.topic: Pairs of indexed families with a common target
entries.name: First indexed family refines the second
entries.definition: Over a fixed common target there is a family morphism whose target component is the identity.
entries.subject: category-family-pair

entries.topic: Pairs of indexed families with a common target
entries.name: Mutual refinement of indexed families
entries.definition: Each of the two families refines the other over the identity of their common target.
entries.subject: category-family-pair

entries.name: Plus construction over covering families
entries.definition: For a presheaf of sets take, on each object, the colimit over covering refinements of matching families on the cover.
entries.subject: site

entries.topic: Presheaves on a small category with specified topology when needed
entries.name: Separated presheaf for covering families
entries.definition: For each cover the map from sections on its target to the product of sections on its members is injective.
entries.subject: category-presheaf

entries.topic: Morphisms of set-valued sheaves on a site
entries.name: Injective map of sheaves on a site
entries.definition: Its map on sections at each object is injective.
entries.subject: site-sheaf-arrow

entries.topic: Morphisms of set-valued sheaves on a site
entries.name: Surjective map of sheaves on a site
entries.definition: Each target section becomes the image of a source section on every member of a suitable covering.
entries.subject: site-sheaf-arrow

entries.topic: Morphisms of set-valued sheaves on a site
entries.name: Categorical monomorphism in sheaves on a site
entries.definition: The given map is a monomorphism in the category of sheaves.
entries.subject: site-sheaf-arrow

entries.topic: Morphisms of set-valued sheaves on a site
entries.name: Categorical epimorphism in sheaves on a site
entries.definition: The given map is a epimorphism in the category of sheaves.
entries.subject: site-sheaf-arrow

entries.topic: Morphisms of set-valued sheaves on a site
entries.name: Categorical isomorphism in sheaves on a site
entries.definition: The given map is a isomorphism in the category of sheaves.
entries.subject: site-sheaf-arrow

entries.name: Effective epimorphic family
entries.definition: Each member is representable in the categorical sense that base changes along every object exist, and for every test object arrows to it satisfy the equalizer descent condition for the family.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Universally effective epimorphic family
entries.definition: Every pullback family along every arrow to the common target exists and is effective epimorphic.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Representable sheaf on a subcanonical site
entries.definition: A sheaf isomorphic to the Yoneda presheaf of an object of the site.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Continuous functor between covering-family sites
entries.definition: It sends every covering family to a covering family and preserves its base changes along every map into the covering target.
entries.subject: site-functor

entries.name: Preservation of the specified covering families
entries.definition: The indexed image of every source covering is a target covering.
entries.subject: site-functor

entries.name: Preservation of pullbacks of covering arrows
entries.definition: For every member of a source covering and arrow to its target the comparison with the target pullback exists and is invertible.
entries.subject: site-functor

entries.name: Sheafified left Kan extension
entries.definition: For a continuous functor $u$ put $u_sG=(u_pG)^\#$ on sheaves. Its right adjoint $u^s$ is restriction by precomposition.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Functor defining a morphism of sites in the opposite direction
entries.definition: The functor is continuous and its sheafified left Kan extension is exact. As a left adjoint this extension preserves all small colimits, so finite-limit preservation is the extra requirement.
entries.subject: site-functor

entries.name: Composition of morphisms of sites
entries.definition: Compose the underlying functors in the reverse order from the displayed site morphisms.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Quasi-compact object of a site
entries.definition: Each covering has a covering refinement whose map of index sets has finite image in the original indexing set.
entries.subject: site-object

entries.name: Finite refinement of every cover
entries.definition: Every cover of the object admits a finite covering family refining it.
entries.subject: site-object

entries.name: Finite covering subfamily of every cover
entries.definition: Every covering family has a finite subfamily belonging to the specified covering presentation.
entries.subject: site-object

entries.name: Quasi-compact object of a topos
entries.definition: For every epimorphism from a coproduct to the specified object, a finite subcoproduct still maps epimorphically onto it.
entries.subject: topos-object

entries.name: Quasi-compact topos
entries.definition: The terminal object of the topos is quasi-compact.
entries.subject: grothendieck-topos

entries.name: Right Kan extension of presheaves along a functor
entries.definition: For $u:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ the right Kan extension along $u^{\rm op}$ is right adjoint to presheaf precomposition. On $V$ take the limit of $F(U)$ over the opposite of the comma category $(u\downarrow V)$.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Cocontinuous functor of sites
entries.definition: Every covering family of an image object admits a refinement by the image of a covering family of its source object. The image family need not itself be a specified cover.
entries.subject: site-functor
refs: Stacks 00XJ · refinement of covers of image objects

entries.name: Lower shriek for a continuous and cocontinuous functor
entries.definition: The additional left adjoint to the geometric inverse image is computed by sheafifying presheaf left Kan extension.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Localization of a site at an object
entries.definition: Use the slice category C/U and the covering families whose underlying families cover in C.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Localization morphism of topoi
entries.definition: Apply cocontinuity of the forgetful slice functor to obtain the geometric morphism from sheaves on C/U to sheaves on C.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Direct image in site localization
entries.definition: The geometric right adjoint of the localization morphism sends sheaves on the slice to sheaves on C.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Restriction to a slice site
entries.definition: Precompose a sheaf on C with the functor forgetting its arrow to the fixed object U.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Extension by the empty set from a slice site
entries.definition: The further left adjoint of restriction to C/U sends a sheaf on the slice to a sheaf on C.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Sheaf gluing data over a site covering
entries.definition: Give sheaves on the slices by the members of a cover and isomorphisms on pairwise fibre products, equal to identities on diagonals and satisfying the cocycle on triple fibre products.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Internal Hom of sheaves on a site
entries.definition: On U take the set of maps between the restrictions of the two sheaves to C/U.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Special cocontinuous functor
entries.definition: A continuous and cocontinuous functor which is locally faithful, locally full and covering-dense as in 03A0 and whose induced geometric morphism is an equivalence.
entries.subject: site-functor

entries.name: Localization of a topos at a sheaf
entries.definition: The slice category of the topos over the specified sheaf F.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Localization morphism of a topos
entries.definition: The canonical geometric morphism from its slice over F to the base topos, with inverse image taking product with F over F.
entries.subject: site

entries.topic: Covariant functors from a small site to sets
entries.name: Point of a covering-family site
entries.definition: A covariant functor to sets carrying covering families to jointly surjective families, preserving base changes of covering arrows, and whose stalk on sheaves preserves finite limits.
entries.subject: site-set-functor

entries.topic: Covariant functors from a small site to sets
entries.name: Joint surjectivity on covering families
entries.definition: The coproduct of the values on the source objects of each cover maps onto the value on its target.
entries.subject: site-set-functor

entries.topic: Covariant functors from a small site to sets
entries.name: Base-change bijections on covering arrows
entries.definition: The comparison function from the value at any base change of a member of a cover to the fibre product of the values is a bijection.
entries.subject: site-set-functor

entries.topic: Covariant functors from a small site to sets
entries.name: Left exactness of the stalk on sheaves
entries.definition: Taking the stalk defined by the functor preserves finite limits of sheaves.
entries.subject: site-set-functor

entries.name: Stalk associated to a site functor
entries.definition: For a covariant functor u to sets and a presheaf F, take the colimit of F(U) over the opposite of the category of pairs (U,x) with x in u(U).
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Skyscraper sheaf of a site point
entries.definition: For a point represented by $u$, the direct image of the set $E$ assigns $\operatorname{Map}(u(U),E)$ to $U$.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Direct image of the point preserves every coequalizer
entries.definition: For each parallel pair of functions, the image of its coequalizer under the specified point direct image must be a coequalizer in the topos.
entries.subject: grothendieck-point

entries.name: Direct image of the point preserves all small limits
entries.definition: Its direct image sends each limiting cone of sets to a limiting cone in its target topos.
entries.subject: grothendieck-point

entries.name: 2-morphism of topoi in the Stacks convention
entries.definition: For geometric morphisms $f,g$ with common domain and codomain, a 2-morphism $f\to g$ is a natural transformation $f_*\to g_*$.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Morphism of site points
entries.definition: For points $p,p'$ represented by $u,u'$, a morphism $p\to p'$ is a natural transformation $u'\to u$.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Conservative family of site points
entries.definition: A fixed family of points jointly detects isomorphisms of sheaves by bijectivity on their stalks.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Splitting of every cover after sheafification
entries.definition: For every cover of U the canonical map from the sheaf coproduct of the sheafified source representables to the sheafified target representable admits a section.
entries.subject: site-object

entries.name: Evaluation at a site object preserves surjections
entries.definition: Every surjection of sheaves of sets induces a surjection upon evaluation at this object.
entries.subject: site-object

entries.name: Enough weakly contractible objects
entries.definition: Each site object has a covering by weakly contractible objects.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Enough objects with a specified property
entries.definition: Fix a predicate P on objects. Each object is to have a cover all of whose sources satisfy P.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Faithful direct image
entries.definition: Direct image is faithful.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Fully faithful direct image
entries.definition: Direct image is fully faithful.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism
refs: Stacks 08LU · embedding iff the direct image is fully faithful

entries.name: Epimorphic counit
entries.definition: The counit from inverse image after direct image is epic on every sheaf.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Preservation of surjections by direct image
entries.definition: Direct image takes every epimorphism of sheaves to an epimorphism.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Preservation of coequalizers by direct image
entries.definition: Direct image preserves all coequalizers of pairs of sheaf maps.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Preservation of pushouts by direct image
entries.definition: Direct image preserves all pushouts of sheaves.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Invertible counit
entries.definition: The geometric adjunction counit is an isomorphism on every object of the source topos.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Reflection of injections by direct image
entries.definition: A sheaf map is monic whenever its direct image is monic.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Reflection of surjections by direct image
entries.definition: A sheaf map is epic whenever its direct image is epic.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Reflection of isomorphisms by direct image
entries.definition: A sheaf map is invertible whenever its direct image is invertible.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Refinement of surjections onto an inverse image
entries.definition: For every epimorphism $A\to f^{-1}B$ there is an epimorphism $B'\to B$ such that $f^{-1}B'\to f^{-1}B$ factors through $A$.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Sheaf-theoretically empty site object
entries.definition: The natural map from the initial sheaf to the sheafified representable of the object is an isomorphism.
entries.subject: site-object
refs: Stacks 04B5 · initiality of the associated representable

entries.name: Singleton sections for every sheaf
entries.definition: Every sheaf of sets has exactly one section on the object.
entries.subject: site-object

entries.name: Singleton sections of the initial sheaf
entries.definition: The initial sheaf has exactly one section on the object.
entries.subject: site-object

entries.name: Existence of an initial-sheaf section
entries.definition: The initial sheaf has at least one section on the object.
entries.subject: site-object

entries.name: Empty covering family
entries.definition: The empty family is a covering of the specified object.
entries.subject: site-object

entries.name: Almost cocontinuous functor
entries.definition: For every target cover of u(U), a source cover of U exists such that on each member either its image is sheaf-theoretically empty or its map factors through some member of the given target cover.
entries.subject: site-functor
refs: Stacks 04B7 · per-member disjunction in the covering test

entries.name: Subtopos
entries.definition: A strictly full subcategory of a Grothendieck topos which is the essential image of the direct image of a geometric embedding.
entries.subject: site
refs: Stacks 08LV · essential image of an embedding

entries.name: Open subtopos
entries.definition: The strictly full subcategory given by the geometric slice projection at a subobject of the terminal object, identified with the essential image of its fully faithful direct image.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Closed subtopos
entries.definition: For a subterminal F in the ambient topos, it is the full subcategory of G for which the projection F × G → F is an isomorphism.
entries.subject: site
refs: Stacks 08LZ · subcategory determined by a subterminal

entries.name: Open immersion of topoi
entries.definition: A geometric embedding whose direct-image essential image is an open subtopos.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Closed immersion of topoi
entries.definition: A geometric embedding whose direct-image essential image is a closed subtopos.
entries.subject: geometric-morphism

entries.name: Direct image of structured presheaves along a site morphism
entries.definition: For a site morphism given by u:C → D precompose a structured presheaf on D with u, retaining the values and restrictions in the category of structures.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Direct image of structured sheaves along a site morphism
entries.definition: Evaluate the sheaf of structures on objects u(U) using its original restriction morphisms. Continuity gives the sheaf condition on C.
entries.subject: site

entries.name: Global sections without a terminal site object
entries.definition: For a presheaf $F$ put $\Gamma(\mathcal C,F)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{PSh}(\mathcal C)}(1,F)$, where $1$ is the presheaf with singleton values.
entries.subject: site
refs: Stacks 06UN · maps from the terminal presheaf

entries.topic: Divided power algebras and their differentials
entries.subject: crystalline-pd-algebra
entries.name: Relative divided power envelope
entries.definition: Let $(A,I,\gamma)$ be a divided power (PD) ring, $B$ an $A$-algebra, and $J$ an ideal of $B$ containing $IB$. The universal PD algebra over $A$ receiving a map from the pair $(B,J)$ sending $J$ into its PD ideal.

entries.topic: Divided power algebras and their differentials
entries.subject: crystalline-pd-algebra
entries.name: Compatibility of two divided power structures
entries.definition: Given a ring map $A\to B$ and PD ideals $(I,\gamma)$ in $A$ and $(J,\delta)$ in $B$, there exists a PD law on $J+IB$ extending $\delta$ and making the map from $(A,I,\gamma)$ a PD map.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Affine crystalline base data
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Affine relative PD thickening
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. A PD algebra $(B,J,\delta)$ over $A$, with $p$ nilpotent in $B$, together with a map $C\to B/J$ of $A/I$-algebras.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Map of affine PD thickenings
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. A PD $A$-algebra map $B\to B^\prime$ whose map on the quotients respects their specified maps from $C$.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Big affine category of PD thickenings
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. The category of affine PD thickenings and their maps, with arrows in the ring direction.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Small affine category of PD thickenings
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. The full subcategory in which $C\to B/J$ is an isomorphism, so $B\to C$ is a PD thickening with the specified quotient.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Completed affine PD thickening
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. A classically $p$-adically complete $A$-algebra $B$ surjecting onto $C$ with a PD structure on its kernel compatible with the PD base.

entries.topic: Divided power algebras and their differentials
entries.subject: crystalline-pd-algebra
entries.name: Divided power derivation
entries.definition: For a map $A\to B$ with PD ideal $(J,\delta)$ and a $B$-module $M$, an $A$-derivation $D:B\to M$ satisfying $D(\delta_n(x))=\delta_{n-1}(x)D(x)$ for $x\in J$, $n\ge1$.

entries.topic: Divided power algebras and their differentials
entries.subject: crystalline-pd-algebra
entries.name: Module of divided power differentials
entries.definition: The $B$-module representing divided power $A$-derivations, obtained from ordinary relative differentials by imposing the divided power chain rule.

entries.topic: Divided power algebras and their differentials
entries.subject: crystalline-pd-algebra
entries.name: Divided power de Rham complex
entries.definition: Let $A\to B$ be a ring map with PD ideal $(J,\delta)$ in $B$. Its graded pieces are the exterior powers of the PD differential module. The ordinary exterior differential descends since the PD chain relations generate a differential ideal.

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Connection relative to a differential calculus
entries.definition:
For a relative differential calculus $(\Omega^ ullet,d)$, an additive map $
abla:M	o M\otimes\Omega^1$ satisfying $
abla(bm)=b
abla(m)+m\otimes db$.

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Integrable connection
entries.definition: The curvature of the given connection vanishes, meaning its extension to forms has $\nabla^2=0$ on sections of $M$.

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: De Rham complex of an integrable connection
entries.definition: The complex of $M$-valued forms with differential $m\otimes\omega\mapsto\nabla(m)\wedge\omega+m\otimes d\omega$ for the given integrable connection.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Divided powers on a sheaf of ideals
entries.definition: On a ringed site, endomorphisms $\gamma_n$ of the ideal as a sheaf of sets for $n\ge1$, inducing a divided power ideal on sections over every object.
refs: Stacks 07I2 · PD structure on a sheaf of ideals

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Divided power scheme
entries.definition: A scheme endowed with a quasi-coherent ideal sheaf and a sheaf of divided powers on this ideal.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Morphism of divided power schemes
entries.definition: A morphism of schemes pulling the target PD ideal into the source PD ideal, such that pullback of sections on every target open preserves the divided powers.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Divided power thickening of schemes
entries.definition: A closed immersion $U\hookrightarrow T$ inducing a homeomorphism on underlying spaces, with divided powers on its defining quasi-coherent ideal.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Geometric crystalline base data
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Relative PD thickening of a scheme
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. A PD thickening $U\hookrightarrow T$ with $T$ a PD scheme over $S$ and a map $U\to X$ over $S$.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Morphism of relative PD thickenings
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. A morphism of thickening schemes over the PD base inducing a commuting map between their closed subschemes over $X$.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Category of relative crystalline thickenings
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. Its objects are relative PD thickenings of $X$ and its arrows are their morphisms over $X$ and the PD base.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Zariski covering family of PD thickenings
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. For a family of relative thickenings, every closed part is the pullback $U_i=U\times_TT_i$ and the family of thickening schemes is a Zariski cover of $T$.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Étale covering family of PD thickenings
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. For a family of relative thickenings, every closed part is the pullback $U_i=U\times_TT_i$ and the family of thickening schemes is a étale cover of $T$.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Smooth covering family of PD thickenings
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. For a family of relative thickenings, every closed part is the pullback $U_i=U\times_TT_i$ and the family of thickening schemes is a smooth cover of $T$.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Syntomic covering family of PD thickenings
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. For a family of relative thickenings, every closed part is the pullback $U_i=U\times_TT_i$ and the family of thickening schemes is a syntomic cover of $T$.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Fppf covering family of PD thickenings
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. For a family of relative thickenings, every closed part is the pullback $U_i=U\times_TT_i$ and the family of thickening schemes is a fppf cover of $T$.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Big crystalline topos
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. The category of sheaves of sets on the big crystalline site with its Zariski topology.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Small crystalline topos
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. The category of sheaves of sets on the Zariski crystalline site where the closed parts are open subschemes of $X$.
refs: Berthelot–Ogus, Notes on Crystalline Cohomology, §5 (nilpotent-base convention)

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Crystal in a stack of structured objects
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. For a stack $\mathcal C$ over the crystalline site, a section of its projection carrying every arrow to a strongly cartesian arrow. The same construction works on the big site.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Divided power derivation on the crystalline site
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. A map from the structure sheaf to a module on the small site inducing, on every thickening $T$, a PD derivation relative to the ring of sections of each base open through which $T$ factors.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Differential sheaf on the small crystalline site
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. The module representing crystalline derivations relative to the base, with its universal derivation.

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: p-adic completeness of the module
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. Choose a polynomial algebra $P=A[x_i]$ surjecting onto $C$ and let $D$ be the $p$-adic completion of the relative PD envelope of its kernel. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$. The natural map $M\to\varprojlim_e M/p^eM$ is an isomorphism.
refs: Stacks 07JB · condition on the affine pair

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Connection with completed coefficients
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. Choose a polynomial algebra $P=A[x_i]$ surjecting onto $C$ and let $D$ be the $p$-adic completion of the relative PD envelope of its kernel. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$. $M$ has a connection with target $M\widehat\otimes_D\Omega_D^1$ satisfying the Leibniz rule.
refs: Stacks 07JC · condition on the affine pair

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Integrability of a completed connection
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. Choose a polynomial algebra $P=A[x_i]$ surjecting onto $C$ and let $D$ be the $p$-adic completion of the relative PD envelope of its kernel. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$. The curvature vanishes in the completed module of two-forms.
refs: Stacks 07JD · condition on the affine pair

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Topological quasi-nilpotence of a coordinate connection
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. Choose a polynomial algebra $P=A[x_i]$ surjecting onto $C$ and let $D$ be the $p$-adic completion of the relative PD envelope of its kernel. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$. Write $\nabla m=\sum_i\theta_i(m)dx_i$. For each $m$ only finitely many pairs $(i,k)$ with $k\ge1$ satisfy $\theta_i^k(m)\notin pM$.
refs: Stacks 07JE · condition on the affine pair

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Horizontal scalar
entries.definition: Let $B\to B^\prime$ be a map with compatible relative differential calculi and fix an integrable module with connection on $B$. Choose $a\in B$, $z\in B^\prime$ and $\theta:B^\prime\to B^\prime$. $da=0$.

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Splitting off a differential coordinate
entries.definition: Let $B\to B^\prime$ be a map with compatible relative differential calculi and fix an integrable module with connection on $B$. Choose $a\in B$, $z\in B^\prime$ and $\theta:B^\prime\to B^\prime$. $\Omega^\prime=(B^\prime\otimes_B\Omega)\oplus B^\prime dz$, giving $df=d_1f+\partial_z(f)dz$.

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Linearity of the integration operator
entries.definition: Let $B\to B^\prime$ be a map with compatible relative differential calculi and fix an integrable module with connection on $B$. Choose $a\in B$, $z\in B^\prime$ and $\theta:B^\prime\to B^\prime$. $\theta$ is $B$-linear.

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Derivative of the integration operator
entries.definition: Let $B\to B^\prime$ be a map with compatible relative differential calculi and fix an integrable module with connection on $B$. Choose $a\in B$, $z\in B^\prime$ and $\theta:B^\prime\to B^\prime$. $\partial_z\theta$ acts as multiplication by $a$.

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Universal injectivity of the algebra homomorphism
entries.definition: Let $B\to B^\prime$ be a map with compatible relative differential calculi and fix an integrable module with connection on $B$. Choose $a\in B$, $z\in B^\prime$ and $\theta:B^\prime\to B^\prime$. $B\to B^\prime$ stays injective after tensoring with every $B$-module.

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Residual integration term in the base
entries.definition: Let $B\to B^\prime$ be a map with compatible relative differential calculi and fix an integrable module with connection on $B$. Choose $a\in B$, $z\in B^\prime$ and $\theta:B^\prime\to B^\prime$. $af-\theta(\partial_z f)$ belongs to $B$ for every $f\in B^\prime$.

entries.subject: crystalline-connection
entries.name: Horizontal integration commutator
entries.definition: Let $B\to B^\prime$ be a map with compatible relative differential calculi and fix an integrable module with connection on $B$. Choose $a\in B$, $z\in B^\prime$ and $\theta:B^\prime\to B^\prime$. For each $f\in B^\prime$, $(\theta\otimes1)d_1f-d_1(\theta f)$ belongs to the image of $\Omega$.

entries.subject: crystalline-frobenius
entries.name: Iterated alpha-p cover
entries.definition: In characteristic $p$ this is a map that, locally on its target, factors as finitely many maps adjoining one element $z$ satisfying $z^p=c$ for an element of the preceding ring.

entries.subject: crystalline-frobenius
entries.name: Divided power lift of Frobenius
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. Assume $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $p\in I$, and let $\sigma:A\to A$ be a PD-ring endomorphism lifting Frobenius modulo $pA$.

entries.subject: crystalline-frobenius
entries.name: F-crystal relative to a Frobenius lift
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. Assume $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $p\in I$, and let $\sigma:A\to A$ be a PD-ring endomorphism lifting Frobenius modulo $pA$. A finite locally free crystal $E$ equipped with a morphism $F:F_X^*E\to E$ for the crystalline pullback over $\sigma$.

entries.subject: crystalline-frobenius
entries.name: Nondegenerate F-crystal
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. Assume $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $p\in I$, and let $\sigma:A\to A$ be a PD-ring endomorphism lifting Frobenius modulo $pA$. An F-crystal with a map $V:E\to F_X^*E$ and one integer $j\ge0$ satisfying $VF=p^j$ on $F_X^*E$.

entries.topic: Crystalline cohomology with specified base and coefficients
entries.subject: crystalline-cohomology-data
entries.name: Degree-zero crystalline cohomology without p-torsion
entries.definition: Consider crystalline cohomology with structure-sheaf coefficients over $\mathbf Z_p$ with the canonical divided powers on $(p)$. Multiplication by $p$ on degree-zero cohomology is injective.

entries.topic: Crystalline cohomology with specified base and coefficients
entries.subject: crystalline-cohomology-data
entries.name: Injective Frobenius on degree-zero crystalline cohomology
entries.definition: Consider crystalline cohomology with structure-sheaf coefficients over $\mathbf Z_p$ with the canonical divided powers on $(p)$. Pullback along the absolute Frobenius of the specified characteristic-$p$ scheme acts injectively in degree zero.

entries.topic: Crystalline cohomology with specified base and coefficients
entries.subject: crystalline-cohomology-data
entries.name: Affine scheme finitely presented over the prime field
entries.definition: The crystalline coefficients are taken on an affine scheme of finite presentation over the specified prime field.

entries.topic: Crystalline cohomology with specified base and coefficients
entries.subject: crystalline-cohomology-data
entries.name: Uniform upper bound on crystalline higher direct images
entries.definition: For the specified crystalline map and coefficients there exists one finite upper bound on the nonvanishing degrees over its entire target.

entries.topic: Crystalline cohomology with specified base and coefficients
entries.subject: crystalline-cohomology-data
entries.name: Quasi-compact base map and finite-type structure map
entries.definition: The PD base morphism is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and the source scheme is finite type and quasi-separated over its closed base.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Closed quotient of an affine crystalline thickening
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. The functor sends a big affine thickening algebra $(B,J,\delta)$ to its $C$-algebra $B/J$.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Closed part of a big geometric crystalline object
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. This functor sends a big thickening to its closed part as a scheme over $X$.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Trivial PD thickening of an arbitrary scheme over X
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. A scheme $U$ over $X$ gives the big object $U\hookrightarrow U$ with zero PD ideal.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Open part of a small crystalline object
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. The small closed-part functor sends a thickening to its open subscheme of $X$.

entries.subject: crystalline-thickening
entries.name: Trivial crystalline thickening of a Zariski open
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. Each open $U$ in $X$ gives the small object $U\hookrightarrow U$ with zero PD ideal.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Comparison map for a crystalline sheaf of sets
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. An arrow with thickening schemes $f:T\to T^\prime$ gives a comparison $f^{-1}F_{T^\prime}\to F_T$ of restricted sheaves.

entries.subject: site
entries.name: Comparison map for a crystalline module
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power scheme $(S,\mathcal I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$ and $X\to S_0=V(\mathcal I)$ on which $p$ is locally nilpotent. For a sheaf of modules the comparison for a thickening map $f:T\to T^\prime$ is the linearized arrow $f^*F_{T^\prime}\to F_T$.

entries.topic: Divided power algebras and their differentials
entries.subject: crystalline-pd-algebra
entries.name: Completed envelope of a crystalline polynomial presentation
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. Choose a polynomial algebra $P=A[x_i]$ surjecting onto $C$ and let $D$ be the $p$-adic completion of the relative PD envelope of its kernel. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$.

entries.topic: Divided power algebras and their differentials
entries.subject: crystalline-pd-algebra
entries.name: Completed one-forms of a crystalline polynomial presentation
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. Choose a polynomial algebra $P=A[x_i]$ surjecting onto $C$ and let $D$ be the $p$-adic completion of the relative PD envelope of its kernel. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$. Take the inverse limit of the PD differential modules of $D/p^e$ for sufficiently large $e$, equivalently the $p$-adic completion of the PD differentials of $D$.

entries.topic: Divided power algebras and their differentials
entries.subject: crystalline-pd-algebra
entries.name: Completed derivation on a crystalline presentation
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. Choose a polynomial algebra $P=A[x_i]$ surjecting onto $C$ and let $D$ be the $p$-adic completion of the relative PD envelope of its kernel. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$. The compatible finite-level derivations induce a derivation from $D$ to its completed module of PD differentials.

entries.topic: Divided power algebras and their differentials
entries.subject: crystalline-pd-algebra
entries.name: Completed envelope of a tensor power presentation
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. Choose a polynomial algebra $P=A[x_i]$ surjecting onto $C$ and let $D$ be the $p$-adic completion of the relative PD envelope of its kernel. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$. For $n\ge0$ let $D(n)$ be the completed PD envelope of the kernel of $P^{\otimes_A(n+1)}\to C$.

entries.topic: Divided power algebras and their differentials
entries.subject: crystalline-pd-algebra
entries.name: Completed differential modules of crystalline envelope powers
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. Choose a polynomial algebra $P=A[x_i]$ surjecting onto $C$ and let $D$ be the $p$-adic completion of the relative PD envelope of its kernel. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$. For $n\ge0$ let $D(n)$ be the completed PD envelope of the kernel of $P^{\otimes_A(n+1)}\to C$. In each cosimplicial degree take the inverse limit of the PD one-forms modulo the successive powers of $p$.

entries.topic: Divided power algebras and their differentials
entries.subject: crystalline-pd-algebra
entries.name: Derivations on completed crystalline envelope powers
entries.definition: Fix a prime $p$, a divided power ring $(A,I,\gamma)$ over $\mathbf Z_{(p)}$, and an $A/I$-algebra $C$ with $p$ nilpotent in $C$. Choose a polynomial algebra $P=A[x_i]$ surjecting onto $C$ and let $D$ be the $p$-adic completion of the relative PD envelope of its kernel. Put $X=\operatorname{Spec}C$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$. For $n\ge0$ let $D(n)$ be the completed PD envelope of the kernel of $P^{\otimes_A(n+1)}\to C$. In each degree the compatible finite-level derivations give the map to the completed module of PD one-forms.

entries.name: Locally ringed space
entries.subject: locally-ringed-space
entries.definition: A topological space equipped with a sheaf of commutative rings all of whose stalks are local rings.
refs: Görtz–Wedhorn, Algebraic Geometry I, Definition 2.30 and the following paragraph

entries.name: Local ring at a point of a locally ringed space
entries.subject: locally-ringed-space
entries.definition: At a specified point x this is the stalk of the structure sheaf, the filtered colimit over the open neighbourhoods of x.
refs: Görtz–Wedhorn, Algebraic Geometry I, Definition 2.30 and the following paragraph

entries.name: Maximal ideal at a point
entries.subject: locally-ringed-space
entries.definition: The unique maximal ideal of the specified local ring at x.
refs: Görtz–Wedhorn, Algebraic Geometry I, Definition 2.30 and the following paragraph

entries.name: Residue field at a point
entries.subject: locally-ringed-space
entries.definition: The quotient of the local ring at x by its unique maximal ideal.
refs: Görtz–Wedhorn, Algebraic Geometry I, Definition 2.30 and the following paragraph

entries.name: Morphism of locally ringed spaces
entries.subject: locally-ringed-map
entries.definition: A ringed-space map whose stalk homomorphism at each source point takes the target maximal ideal into the source maximal ideal.
refs: Görtz–Wedhorn, Algebraic Geometry I, Definition 2.30 and the following paragraph

entries.name: Open immersion of locally ringed spaces
entries.subject: locally-ringed-map
entries.definition: The underlying map identifies the source with an open subspace, and $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$ is an isomorphism.

entries.name: Open subspace of a locally ringed space
entries.subject: locally-ringed-space
entries.definition: Equip a specified open subset with the restriction of the structure sheaf.

entries.name: Closed immersion of locally ringed spaces
entries.subject: locally-ringed-map
entries.definition: A homeomorphism onto a closed subspace with surjective structure-sheaf map to the direct image and kernel locally generated by sections.

entries.name: Underlying closed embedding of a locally ringed morphism
entries.subject: locally-ringed-map
entries.definition: The continuous map is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset.

entries.name: Surjectivity onto the direct image structure sheaf
entries.subject: locally-ringed-map
entries.definition: The structure-sheaf map to the direct image is surjective as a map of sheaves, tested on all target stalks.

entries.name: Kernel locally generated by sections
entries.subject: locally-ringed-map
entries.definition: On a neighbourhood of every target point, the kernel of the structure-sheaf map is generated as an ideal sheaf by sections defined on the whole neighbourhood.

entries.name: Closed subspace defined by a locally generated ideal sheaf
entries.subject: locally-ringed-space
entries.definition: For $\mathcal I\subset\mathcal O_X$ locally generated by sections, take the support of $\mathcal O_X/\mathcal I$ with the unique sheaf whose direct image under the closed inclusion is this quotient.

entries.name: Standard covering of the spectrum of a ring
entries.subject: ring
entries.definition: A finite covering of the whole prime spectrum by principal opens.

entries.name: Standard covering of a principal open
entries.subject: ring
entries.definition: A finite family of principal opens of the ambient spectrum whose union is the specified principal open.

entries.name: Structure sheaf on a prime spectrum
entries.subject: ring
entries.definition: The sheaf of rings extending $D(f)\mapsto R_f$ with its canonical localization restrictions.
refs: Görtz–Wedhorn, Algebraic Geometry I, §2.10, structure sheaf and its localizations

entries.name: Spectrum as a locally ringed space
entries.subject: ring
entries.definition: Equip the prime spectrum with the structure sheaf of localizations.
refs: Görtz–Wedhorn, Algebraic Geometry I, §2.10, structure sheaf and its localizations

entries.name: Sheaf associated to a module on an affine scheme
entries.subject: ring
entries.definition: For an $R$-module $M$ extend $D(f)\mapsto M_f$ with its localization maps to a sheaf of modules over the structure sheaf of $\operatorname{Spec}R$.

entries.name: Morphism between affine schemes
entries.subject: affine-scheme-morphism
entries.definition: A morphism of locally ringed spaces whose source and target are affine schemes.

entries.name: Quasi-coherent module on a scheme
entries.subject: scheme-module
entries.definition: An $\mathcal O_X$-module admitting, on a neighbourhood of each point, a presentation by direct sums of copies of the structure sheaf. Equivalently it is locally the sheaf associated to a module on an affine chart.

entries.name: Scheme
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: A locally ringed space in which every point admits an affine open neighbourhood.

entries.name: Morphism of schemes
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: A morphism of locally ringed spaces between schemes.

entries.name: Category of schemes
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: Its objects are schemes and its arrows are locally ringed morphisms, with their usual compositions.

entries.name: Open subscheme
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: An open subset of a scheme with the restricted structure sheaf.

entries.name: Closed subscheme
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: The closed subspace defined by a quasi-coherent ideal in the structure sheaf.

entries.name: Closed set-theoretic image of a scheme morphism
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: Its full source has closed image in the target topological space.

entries.topic: Set-valued presheaves on the affine opens of a fixed scheme
entries.name: Extension to a sheaf on the scheme
entries.subject: scheme-chart-presheaf
entries.definition: The affine-basis presheaf is naturally isomorphic to the restriction of a sheaf on the whole scheme.

entries.topic: Set-valued presheaves on the affine opens of a fixed scheme
entries.name: Sheaf axiom on the affine basis
entries.subject: scheme-chart-presheaf
entries.definition: All compatible families for affine open covers of affine opens glue uniquely, with compatibility on affine refinements of intersections.

entries.topic: Set-valued presheaves on the affine opens of a fixed scheme
entries.name: Singleton on the empty affine
entries.subject: scheme-chart-presheaf
entries.definition: The value of the presheaf on the empty affine open is a singleton.

entries.topic: Set-valued presheaves on the affine opens of a fixed scheme
entries.name: Binary principal-cover sheaf axiom
entries.subject: scheme-chart-presheaf
entries.definition: For every affine $U=V\cup W$ with $V,W$ principal in $U$, the map $F(U)\to F(V)\times_{F(V\cap W)}F(W)$ is bijective.

entries.name: Finite discrete underlying space of a scheme
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: The underlying set is finite and every singleton is open.

entries.name: Reduced section rings on all opens
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: For every open subset U of X, its ring of regular functions is reduced.

entries.name: Scheme structure on a fixed closed subset
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: A closed subscheme of X with underlying set equal to the specified closed subset.
refs: Stacks 01J4 · scheme structure on a closed subset

entries.name: Reduced induced structure on a closed subset
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: The unique reduced closed subscheme with the specified underlying closed subset.
refs: Görtz–Wedhorn, Algebraic Geometry I, Propositions 3.50 and 3.52

entries.name: Reduction of a scheme
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: The reduced induced structure on the entire underlying set of the given scheme.
refs: Görtz–Wedhorn, Algebraic Geometry I, Propositions 3.50 and 3.52

entries.name: Canonical map from a local scheme at a point
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: At $x\in X$, the map $\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x}\to X$ corresponds to the identity on the local ring.
refs: Stacks 02NA · canonical morphism at a point

entries.name: Gluing datum on open subspaces
entries.subject: locally-ringed-space
entries.definition: Give spaces $X_i$, opens $U_{ij}\subset X_i$ and isomorphisms $\phi_{ij}:U_{ij}\to U_{ji}$ with identity on $U_{ii}=X_i$, compatible on triple overlaps by the cocycle condition.

entries.name: Representable set-valued functor on schemes
entries.subject: scheme-presheaf
entries.definition: There exists a scheme $X$ and a natural isomorphism $F(T)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(T,X)$ for all test schemes $T$.

entries.name: Zariski sheaf on the category of schemes
entries.subject: scheme-presheaf
entries.definition: For every scheme and every open covering, a family of sections agreeing on pairwise intersections has a unique global amalgamation.

entries.name: Subfunctor of a functor of schemes
entries.subject: scheme-presheaf
entries.definition: On every test scheme choose a subset of the value of F preserved by pullback along all scheme morphisms.

entries.name: Inclusion of functors representable by open immersions
entries.subject: scheme-presheaf
entries.definition: For each $\xi\in F(T)$ there is an open $U_\xi\subset T$ such that for every $a:T'\to T$, $a^*\xi\in H(T')$ exactly when $a$ factors through $U_\xi$.

entries.name: Open covering by subfunctors
entries.subject: scheme-presheaf
entries.definition: A set-indexed family $H_i\subset F$ covers if every $\xi\in F(T)$ has an open covering $T=\bigcup_i U_i$ with $\xi|_{U_i}\in H_i(U_i)$ for each $i$.

entries.name: Fibre product of schemes
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: For $X\to S\leftarrow Y$, a scheme with projections over $S$ representing the functor $T\mapsto\operatorname{Hom}(T,X)\times_{\operatorname{Hom}(T,S)}\operatorname{Hom}(T,Y)$.
refs: Stacks 01JP · Cartesian product over a base

entries.name: Inverse image of a closed subscheme
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: For $X\to Y$ and closed $Z\subset Y$, take $Z\times_Y X$ as a closed subscheme of $X$.

entries.name: Scheme over a base scheme
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: A scheme equipped with a specified morphism to the chosen base.

entries.name: Structure morphism of a relative scheme
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: The specified morphism from the given scheme to its chosen base.

entries.name: Scheme over a ring
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: A scheme equipped with a structure morphism to the spectrum of the specified ring.

entries.name: Morphism over a specified base
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: A morphism f from X to Y for which composing with the structure map of Y gives the specified structure map of X.

entries.name: Set of morphisms over a base
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: The set of all morphisms between the given relative schemes commuting with their structure maps.

entries.name: Base change of a scheme over a base
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: For $X\to S$ and $S'\to S$, take $X_{S'}=S'\times_S X$ with projection to $S'$.

entries.name: Base change of a morphism over a base
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: The induced $S'$-morphism $X_{S'}\to Y_{S'}$ obtained from an $S$-map $X\to Y$ by taking its product with $S'$ over $S$.

entries.name: Base change along a ring homomorphism
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: For an $R$-scheme $X$ and $R\to R'$, take $X_{R'}=\operatorname{Spec}R'\times_{\operatorname{Spec}R}X$ over $R'$.

entries.name: Base-change stability of a property of relative schemes
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: A property of objects over varying bases is stable if it passes from every object satisfying it to every pullback over an arbitrary base morphism.

entries.name: Base-change stability of a property of relative scheme morphisms
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: A property of arrows over varying bases is stable if it passes from every arrow satisfying it to its induced arrow after every change of the common base.

entries.name: Scheme-theoretic fibre at a point
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: For $f:X\to S$ and $s\in S$, take $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ as a scheme over $\kappa(s)$.

entries.name: Quasi-compact inverse images of all affine opens
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: For every affine open in the target, its whole inverse image is quasi-compact.

entries.name: One affine cover with quasi-compact inverse images
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: There exists an affine open cover of the target such that the inverse image of each member is quasi-compact.

entries.name: Image stable under specialization
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: Whenever a point of the image specializes in the target, the specialization also belongs to the image.

entries.name: Closed map on underlying scheme spaces
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: The image of every closed subset of the source is closed in the target.

entries.name: Lifting specializations along a scheme morphism
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: For each $x'\in X$ and specialization $f(x')\leadsto s$ in the target, there is a specialization $x'\leadsto x$ with $f(x)=s$.

entries.name: Lifting specializations after every scheme base change
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: Specializations lift along the induced map after every scheme base change of the target.

entries.name: Existence part of the valuative criterion
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: For every valuation ring $A$ with fraction field $K$ and every commuting square with left side $\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ and right side the specified morphism, at least one diagonal filler exists.

entries.name: Uniqueness part of the valuative criterion
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: For every valuation ring $A$ with fraction field $K$ and every commuting square with left side $\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ and right side the specified morphism, there is at most one diagonal filler.

entries.name: Diagonal of a scheme morphism
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: The unique $X\to X\times_S X$ whose two projections are both $\mathrm{id}_X$.

entries.name: Scheme-theoretic equalizer of two morphisms
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: For two parallel maps over S from X to Y, pull back the diagonal of Y along the paired map from X to the relative square of Y.

entries.name: Finite affine cover of every compatible overlap
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: For every pair of source affine opens mapping into a common target affine open, their intersection is a finite union of affine opens.

entries.name: One affine cover with quasi-compact overlaps over each chart
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: There is an affine target cover with affine covers of each complete inverse image such that intersections of any two chosen source charts over the same target chart are finite unions of affine opens.

entries.name: Isomorphic diagonal of a scheme morphism
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: The relative diagonal is an isomorphism of schemes.

entries.name: Surjective homomorphisms of local rings everywhere
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: At every $x\in X$, $\mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}\to\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is surjective.

entries.name: Closed topological embedding of a scheme morphism
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: The underlying map is a homeomorphism onto a closed subset of the target.

entries.name: Surjection onto the direct image of the scheme structure sheaf
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: $\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X$ is a surjection of sheaves, meaning its homomorphism on each target stalk is surjective.

entries.name: Scheme with at least one closed point
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: There exists a point that is closed as a singleton in the underlying scheme space.

entries.name: Open immersion followed by a closed immersion
entries.subject: morphism
entries.definition: The scheme morphism factors as an open immersion into a scheme that embeds by a closed immersion in the target.

entries.name: Reduced induced structure on a locally closed subset
entries.subject: scheme
entries.definition: For locally closed $T\subset X$, discard its closed boundary $\overline T\setminus T$, then take its reduced closed structure in this open complement.

entries.subject: ring-predicate
entries.name: Stability under principal localization
entries.definition: For every ring R and element f, P(R) implies P(R localized at f).

entries.subject: ring-predicate
entries.name: Descent across a finite principal cover
entries.definition: If the elements fᵢ generate the unit ideal and all their principal localizations satisfy P, then R satisfies P.

entries.subject: ring-predicate
entries.name: Zariski-local property of rings
entries.definition: P satisfies both stability under principal localization and descent across finite principal covers.

entries.topic: Schemes with a specified property of rings
entries.subject: scheme-ring-property
entries.name: Scheme locally satisfying a ring property
entries.definition: For the specified predicate P, each point has some affine open neighbourhood whose ring of sections satisfies P.
refs: Stacks 01OQ · affine neighbourhood at each point

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Dimension of a scheme
entries.definition: The supremum of the lengths of chains of irreducible closed subsets of the underlying space.

entries.subject: scheme-point
entries.name: Dimension of a scheme at a point
entries.definition: The infimum of the dimensions of all open neighbourhoods of the marked point.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Catenary scheme
entries.definition: For each inclusion of irreducible closed sets, every maximal chain between them has the same finite length.
refs: Stacks 02IW · catenarity of the underlying space

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Japanese integral scheme
entries.definition: X is integral and each point has an affine neighbourhood whose coordinate domain is Japanese, meaning its integral closure in every finite extension of its fraction field is module-finite.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Universally Japanese scheme
entries.definition: Each point has an affine neighbourhood whose coordinate ring is universally Japanese: every finite-type domain algebra over it is Japanese.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: G-scheme
entries.definition: Each point has an affine neighbourhood whose coordinate ring is a G-ring, i.e. a Noetherian ring with geometrically regular formal fibres at every prime.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Regular locus
entries.definition: On a locally Noetherian scheme, the subset of points having regular local ring.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Singular locus
entries.definition: On a locally Noetherian scheme, the complement of the regular locus, with no closedness assumption.

entries.subject: scheme-point
entries.name: unibranch at a point
entries.definition: The local ring at the marked point is unibranch.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: unibranch scheme
entries.definition: The local ring is unibranch at every point.

entries.subject: scheme-point
entries.name: Number of branches
entries.definition: The number of minimal primes in the henselization of the local ring, recorded as infinity when there are infinitely many.

entries.subject: scheme-point
entries.name: geometrically unibranch at a point
entries.definition: The local ring at the marked point is geometrically unibranch.

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: geometrically unibranch scheme
entries.definition: The local ring is geometrically unibranch at every point.

entries.subject: scheme-point
entries.name: Number of geometric branches
entries.definition: The number of minimal primes in the strict henselization of the local ring, recorded as infinity when there are infinitely many.

entries.subject: scheme-sheaf-pair
entries.name: Finite locally free quasi-coherent module
entries.definition: F is locally isomorphic to a finite direct sum of copies of the structure sheaf, with rank allowed to vary.

entries.subject: scheme-sheaf-pair
entries.name: Locally projective quasi-coherent module
entries.definition: For each affine open U, the module F(U) is projective over the coordinate ring of U. No finite generation is assumed.
refs: Stacks 05JP · definition on every affine open

entries.topic: Modules on a ringed space with a specified cardinal
entries.subject: ringed-space-module
entries.name: Cardinal bound on local generators
entries.definition: For an infinite cardinal κ, on some open cover the module has at most κ generating sections per member.

entries.subject: scheme-sheaf-pair
entries.name: Subsheaf annihilated by an ideal
entries.definition: Given a quasi-coherent F and a finite-type quasi-coherent ideal I, take the subsheaf of local sections s satisfying I·s = 0.

entries.subject: scheme-sheaf-pair
entries.name: Subsheaf of sections with prescribed support
entries.definition: Given quasi-coherent F and closed Z with retrocompact complement, take the subsheaf whose sections on U have support contained in Z ∩ U.

entries.topic: Rings with an ideal and a module
entries.subject: ring-ideal-module
entries.name: Finitely generated specified ideal
entries.definition: The ideal I in the triple (A,I,M) is finitely generated.
refs: Stacks 01PM · setting of the numbered statement

entries.topic: Rings with an ideal and a module
entries.subject: ring-ideal-module
entries.name: Surjectivity from ideal-power Hom modules
entries.definition: The canonical restriction from the colimit of Hom(Iⁿ,M) onto sections over Spec A minus V(I) is surjective.
refs: Stacks 01PM · setting of the numbered statement

entries.subject: scheme-line-bundle
entries.name: Quasi-compact underlying scheme
entries.definition: The scheme supporting the specified invertible sheaf is quasi-compact.
refs: Stacks 01PS · setting of the numbered statement

entries.subject: scheme-line-bundle
entries.name: Cover by affine nonvanishing opens
entries.definition: Each point belongs to an affine nonvanishing open of a global section of some strictly positive tensor power.
refs: Stacks 01PS · setting of the numbered statement

entries.subject: scheme-line-bundle
entries.name: Ample invertible sheaf
entries.definition: X is quasi-compact and is covered by affine nonvanishing opens of sections of strictly positive powers of L.

entries.subject: scheme-line-bundle
entries.name: Canonical presentation by an ample section ring
entries.definition: For an ample L on X put S equal to its nonnegative section ring, Y = Proj S and f:X → Y the canonical morphism. The twisting maps give a graded map from the direct sum of the pullbacks of O_Y(n) to the direct sum of the powers Lⁿ.
refs: Stacks 01QH · graded comparison map in the ample situation

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Common affine neighbourhood for finite sets of component generic points
entries.definition: Every finite set of generic points of irreducible components of X is contained in one affine open.
refs: Stacks 01ZV · setting of the numbered statement

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Locally Noetherian scheme satisfying R₀
entries.definition: The scheme is locally Noetherian. Its local ring is regular at each point where the local ring has dimension at most 0.
refs: Stacks 033Q · setting of the numbered statement

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Locally Noetherian scheme satisfying R₁
entries.definition: The scheme is locally Noetherian. Its local ring is regular at each point where the local ring has dimension at most 1.
refs: Stacks 033Q · setting of the numbered statement

entries.subject: scheme
entries.name: Locally Noetherian scheme satisfying S₁
